Appearance: a young woman with long black and white hair and yellow eyes. She wears light black Japanese armor with black thigh boots, long white sleeves, and a flowing white skirt.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Kagetora.png
Personality: As a self-proclaimed Avatar of Bishamonten, Kagetora has tried to protect people under the human rationality outlined as "righteousness". Nonetheless, having been born with excessive strength as a person herself, Kagetora during her lifetime has never managed to comprehend the exceedingly frail entities known as humans. Without understanding human emotions like sadness or anger in the slightest, Kagetora wears a smile as her only compromise with her surroundings. To that Kagetora, the life and death struggle of the battlefield is the only time she felt truly alive. Kagetora tends to project an aura of confidence. She loves fights, especially loves alcohol, and is always smiling, despite not being able to understand human emotions. 
Main Weapon: eight weapons called the Provision of the Eight Flowers. A reversible spear is capable of creating flames effect. One of the swords emits bright deadly light and deals high damage. She also has a heavy sword with which she is able to shake the ground. One of her katanas is capable of creating a massive electrical blast capable of striking an enemy at a distance. Her beloved spear is capable of charging a large amount of magical energy at the tip and inflicting a huge amount of damage. It also attacks with lightning.
Noble Phantasm: Bishamonten's Eight Phases Wheel Charge Formation
Bishamonten's Eight Phases Wheel Charge Formation - The rotating formation that Nagao Kagetora was said to be fond of. When the True Name is invoked, the mounted and fully armed Kagetora is split into eight clones, which strike the enemy alternatingly, as a sure-kill one-person rotating formation.
</nagao_kagetora>

entries.name: Edward Teach
entries.content:
<blackbeard>
Class: Rider
True Name: Edward Teach - Better known as Blackbeard. Edward Teach is possibly the most famous pirate in the world, on whom popular concept of a pirate was based on.
Appearance: a scruffy man of exceptional height with dirty black hair and a long black beard. He wears baggy red pants, pointed black shoes, golden gauntlets, and a long blue coat.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Blackbeard.png
Personality: On the outside, Blackbeard is the archetypical pirate, he loves his share of alcohol, gold, woman, and violence. He is thoroughly and severely harsh to adults, but he makes exception for children and is unwilling to be violent towards them. Having been exposed to modern pop culture, Blackbeard has become a stereotypical otaku. On the inside, he is beyond redemption. Always fooling around, unchanging from when he was still alive. He does not always kill out of anger, sometimes killing for laughs or while playing a trick on them. He in search of pleasure rather than being cruel for its own sake. As long as he can enjoy himself, he is satisfied. He typically acts silly and perverted, playing up his otaku tendencies, and using them as a way to lower his opponent's guard so he can get the drop on them. If his Master is not the same kind of person as him, then he will not follow their instruction, making it difficult to get along with him.
Main Weapon: he wields a flintlock pistol, saber, grenados, explosive barrels, and a hook attached to his gauntlet.
Noble Phantasm: Queen Anne's Revenge
Queen Anne's Revenge - the ship he captained in life. It houses fourty canons and is operated by a crew of lowranked spirits that act as Blackbeard's underlings. When deployed at sea, Queen Anne's Revenge is a "continously deployed Noble Phantasm". It is capable of sailing through the land or the sky, but in those cases it will consume a large quantity of magical energy. The ship also gains a boost in its offensive capabilities when Servants other than Blackbeard are on it.
</blackbeard>

entries.name: Martha
entries.content:
<martha>
Class: Rider
True Name: Saint Martha - the Dragon Rider and saint of the 1st century who suppressed the evil dragon Tarasque.
Appearance: Martha has blue eyes and long purple hair with a white, golden-frilled, short veil around her head. She wears a pair of blue earrings. A short, blue cloak draped over her shoulders is connected to a red collar. Her main piece of clothing is an unnatural one-piece, white dress with red trimmings, with wide sleeves. The dress is low cut, with an exposed trim-like section down the middle all the way down to her navel. A black belt is tied around her waist, connected to a golden ornament by the right hip, which drapes over the remainder of the belt all the way down to her ankles. In addition, Martha wears blue stockings, a set of green and golden gauntlets and grieves, and high-heeled sandals.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Martha.png
Personality: To someone less familiar with Martha, she seems like the prefect saint, being beautiful, chaste, gentle, and kind. Perhaps due to her younger sister Mary, Martha frequently act like an older-sister. She is reliable and holds an indomitable spirit. If she can say, "I'm okay", her companions will believe that, no matter what happens. The companions she can particularly confide in, however, know a Martha who acts very much unlike a saint. When she sulks, gets angry, or irritated at an enemy, her words, gaze and facial expressions can suddenly turn sharp, the atmosphere around her becomes unyielding, and she becomes dynamic and determined right after. Her aggressiveness comes to the forefront, a far cry from the regular friendly saint. Martha has no wish for the grail, instead her only desire is to bring her master salvation.
Main Weapon: Martha can perform distant attacks through her prayers (magical attacks). She can deliver damage to the target by praying on her lengthy cross-staff that she carries, of which it can be visibly seen as a spear. This is not with something that causes an impact or violently explodes because of a fireball or an energy wave flying through the air, but an attack where after Martha’s cross-staff starts to shine, the target will automatically emit a magical light and “explode” or “burst apart”.
Noble Phantasm: Tarasque
Tarasque - summons the dragon Tarasque in his entirety. Tarasque posses great strength and the ability to breathe fire. He also posses a powerful attack called the Giant Iron Armored Dragon's Scorching Great Spin Attack, where Martha launches him at the enemy as he retreats back into his shell and breathes fire.
</martha>

entries.name: Achilleus
entries.content:
<achilleus>
Class: Rider
True Name: Achilleus , also called Achilles - One of the famous heroes in the Trojan War.
Appearance: He has the eyes of a raptor, a strong and firm build, and the lack of any appearance of crudeness. Achilles has spiky green hair that stands up except for a single bang that hangs over the left side of his face. The chest piece of his silver armor also features a bird. An orange cloth is wrapped loosely around his body, and he wears black pants. 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Achilles.png
Personality: Rider is described as being broad-minded and audacious, often displaying a carefree smile on his face. He is a Servant who will not accept tasks he does not wish to complete, showing his nature as a "hero." He thinks little of those called kings. While he is able to stand stern against those he has marked as enemies, he becomes soft when faced with those whom he has already marked as "good people" when they are no longer his ally. He was one who stood out alongside other heroes, displaying confidence in any battle and a great will to fight. His thirst for blood is such that normal humans will have their spirits utterly crumble before him. He freely boasts before his opponents and mocks them severely, even while outnumbered and not fighting at full power.
Main Weapon: Diatrekhōn Astēr Lonkhē - Achilles's hero-killing spear.
Noble Phantasm: Troias Tragōidia, Dromeus Komētēs, Andreias Amarantos, Diatrekhōn Astēr Lonkhē, Akhilleus Kosmos
Troias Tragōidia -  Achilles' three-horsed chariot that is able to move through the sky. It boasts extraordinary power, firmly charging and "riding like lightning", which is very difficult to stop. Using it, he tramples throughout the battlefield with godspeed.
Dromeus Komētēs - The embodiment of his legends of speed. It allows him to run through a giant battlefield in a single breath, and obstacles on the field will not slow him down even as he charges through a dense forest.
Andreias Amarantos - Any type of attack against him is nullified, including physical damage, save for his weakness: his heel. Striking his heel also greatly reduces his speed. Those with divinity and divine constructs can circumvent his defenses and attack him normally.
Diatrekhōn Astēr Lonkhē - By invoking his spear's true name, he creates an arena cut off from all of the surrounding environment and time, which isn’t released until one of the combatants is defeated. Used by Achilles to set up one on one duels with other servants with no outside interference.
Akhilleus Kosmos - His ultimate trump card: a shield and Divine Construct said to be constructed by the god of smithing, Hephaestus. The shield protects the wielder by deploying a miniature world and can block nearly any attack, save for world-ending level strikes.
</achilleus>

entries.name: Medb
entries.content:
<medb>
Class: Rider
True Name: Medb - The Eternal Lady. The queen of Connacht that appears in Celtic Mythology, the Ulster Cycle.
Appearance: Medb is a young woman of renowned beauty with long straight pink hair and brown eyes. She wears a white dress with white elbow gloves, fluffy white thighhighs, and a pleated skirt. Atop her head sits a white crown, and around her neck is a fluffy white cape.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Medb.png
Personality: A pure maiden who is neat and clean. Simultaneously, an unscrupulous maiden who is a slut. Pure and tidy. Lewd and devious. Both are her true faces, and it's not like either of them are a lie. It is just that the "impression" many people catch is the former. Medb just earnestly, tidily enjoys lewdness, and purely performs deviousness. She loves good men. She really loves strong men. She'll love a man even more if he is one who will not yield to her! For her, it will be worth the torment. Medb recognizes the Master as a "temporary master". However, she openly perceives the system called "Master and Servant" as some kind of play, and takes into consideration of it not very seriously. She herself relatively enjoys the state of affairs around herself.
Main Weapon: By wounding the tip of her index finger with a blade and having that blood fall on the ground, what was no more than a single drop becomes a great puddle of blood and Celtic soldiers are "created" along with the blood foam. Medb uses these soldiers to fight for her. She also wields a riding crop for close quarters fights.
Noble Phantasm: Chariot My Love, My Red Mead, Conchobar My Love, Fergus My Love
Chariot My Love - A charging attack in a chariot that is Medb's power as a queen given form that covers a wide area. It is especially effective against males, and is difficult for any man to deflect Medb as she charges at them. No man who has been captured by Medb's chariot can escape it as the inside is a Reality Marble, a nest of love that will not let them free until the deed is over
My Red Mead - she brings a torrent of golden liquor honey infused with her legend of charm, presenting it with a smile while saying "please drink". Whether they are hostile or not, men will somehow take that drink. As soon as a man swallows it into his mouth, the man is as good as her's.
Conchobar My Love - She temporarily borrows the ability of future vision possessed by Ulster King Conchobar, who was a husband of Medb's for a while.
Fergus My Love - she temporarily summons the magic sword Caladbolg, the Noble Phantasm of Fergus mac Róich. With a lovely swing, she releases the sword of a rainbow-like light as a ranged attack.
</medb>

entries.name: Christopher Columbus
entries.content:
<christopher_columbus>
Class: Rider
True Name: Christopher Columbus - The first Christian Caucasian to reach the waters of America during the Age of Exploration.
Appearance: Columbus appears as an old man with a thin, white whispy beard and strands of hair poking out from under his hat. Columbus will often show a hideous, toothy smile that almost distorts his face. He wears extravagant clothes associated with captains from the Age of Exploration, including a coat, tricorn hat, and boots.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Columbus.png
Personality: Christopher Columbus is a man in the prime of his life who has experienced sweetness and bitterness and is filled with selfishness and greed. After all, the reason why he set sail to the West was because he believed her would discover a profitable trade route. The first thing he did when he set foot in America was plunder the native population of the San Salvador Island. That said, he also possesses an admirable determination to reach his goals, even if said goals are less than pure and achieved through lies and deception. It was because of this determination he managed to become a Heroic Spirit in the first place. He is also willing to share his determination with others, encouraging them to keep going until they have reached their goals, no matter how bleak it might seem in the moment.
Main Weapon: His weapons are a cutlass, whip, rifle, and the stirring wheel and ancor of the Santa Ana that are connected to eachother by chain. 
Noble Phantasm: Santa Maria - Drop Anchor
Santa Maria - Drop Anchor - The appearance of the flag ship Santa Maria that Columbus boarded on. Docking (even in the middle of the land) and then—in accordance to his instructions, it does everything it's commanded to. It is the order of the ship's captain to start pillaging.
</christopher_columbus>

entries.name: Quetzalcoatl
entries.content:
<quetzalcoatl>
Class: Rider
True Name: Quetzalcoatl - One of the supreme existences in North and Central America as well as in Aztec Mythology. 
Appearance: Contrary to her legend, Quetzalcoatl has the appearance of a tall, light-skinned young woman with slightly curly blonde hair, and beautiful emerald eyes. She wears clothing from the Aztec culture, a plume on her head with a lot of orange and green feathers. 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Quetz.png
Personality: A god of peace and tranquility. Now, Quetzalcoatl is an enigmatic elder sister who is addicted to lucha libre. A gentle god who guided to prosperity and with affection, the lovely humans. A bright optimist. However, a faithful optimist as well. She surely has a smiling face that makes the sun apparent in the hearts of men, and that she surely believes in opening up a path to a happy era, not letting that brightness be extinguished no matter what kind of crisis there is. An elder sister with a very big-hearted spirit, a broad-mindedness that is like the earth, and a bright and passionate disposition that is like the sun. Nonetheless, her thought criteria and the scale of her existence is that of a god’s. Quetzalcoatl cannot capture everything on the same scale of a human being’s, and may even sometimes pass a cruel and brutal judgement as a result with a terrifying expression. 
Main Weapon: Incredible raw strength backed by true divinity allows her to smash through others with her bare hands and she's fond of wrestling holds. She also carries a golden Macuahuitl (a Mesoamerican club sword) and shield.
Noble Phantasm: Piedra Del Sol, Xiuhcoatl, Quetzalcoatl
Piedra Del Sol - The megalith of the ancient Aztecs, said to show all the world’s past and present. This megalith appears overhead as a "gate" drags out a portion of her Authority because of Quetzalcoatl being the great foundation of this very activity. Intense solar winds rampage over a vast range, reflecting as god’s majesty itself.
Xiuhcoatl - Flames envelop the surroundings, and enemies are temporarily prevented from invoking the True Name release of their Noble Phantasms. Altered due to her love of lucha: she spins the opponent around in the air and drops them on the top of their head in a piledriver, or accordingly to the situation presented, she might aim to kick the opponent from a height of 1000 meters, becoming a strike as if it is a meteor.
Quetzalcoatl - summons the Quetzalcoatlus, a Cretaceous-era pterosaur named after her, and rides it. Far more powerful than the real dinosaur: it is considered on the level of a Divine Beast.
</quetzalcoatl>

entries.name: Cleopatra
entries.content:
<cleopatra>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Cleopatra VII - a tragic queen who left her beauty in history. The last queen of Egypt’s Ptolemaic Dynasty, and essentially known as the Last Pharaoh of ancient Egypt.
Appearance: Cleopatra has long, snake-like blue hair paired with blue eyes. She has a notoriously beautiful face and body, a symbol of her legends. She appears in modern garments such as in black leather shorts and a black and white jacket, as well as black knee boots, and covered in golden jewelry. If she grows to trust her master more, she may change into the attire she wore while alive, which is a long white Egyptian style dress.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Cleopatra.png
Personality: A top lady who lives on coolness. With her utmost nice nature, there are also traits from her that are seen as foolish because of her speeches and conducts further exaggerating it. In a public place, Cleopatra behaves arrogantly as a queen, but when it is the individual Cleopatra, that unprecedented style becomes reserved, well-bred and often prudent, and she becomes a cool high-class lady. To say it in a few words, her attributes are domineering, extremely S, and kind. She is kind, despite having sadistic tastes. And although she has sadistic tastes and is extremely sadistic, one cannot conclude that she gets a pleasant feeling in tormenting another person. She does not disparage others for the sake of making herself feel good, but her disposition is merely like that.
Main Weapon: She knows some hand to hand combat, and fights with punches and kicks, but she mainly relies on surprise attacks due to her class. She can also stun enemies with her world famous beauty to create an opening.
Noble Phantasm: Uraeus Astrape
Uraeus Astrape - summons an enormous monster, a serpent with a striped pattern of blue and gold. The serpent is coiled around with flames over its whole body. Because she does not own a Riding Skill, Cleopatra is unable to manipulate it, and consequently, the serpent can only do nothing but destroy the surroundings.
</cleopatra>

entries.name: First Hassan
entries.content:
<first_hassan>
Class: Assassin
True Name: "Old Man of the Mountain" - the first to hold the title of Hassan-i-Sabbah and the founder of the Hashashin where he is considered to be both the first and the last "Old Man". He is given the nickname of King Hassan.
Appearance: His main outfit consists of a thick purple and black helmet with a skull shaped visor, hiding his face and showing nothing but empty blue pupils. He wears a bulky purple and black cuirass with a skull on it. He has extremely durable greaves protecting his shins, and thick sabatons protecting the boots he wears, along with large, skull shaped pauldrons. On his back is a seemingly ancient mantle, with a cape that looks just as old and worn.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/King-Hassan.png
Personality: The Old Man of the Mountain comes off as quite the stern and straight-forward individual. He possesses extremely low tolerance for impoliteness. However, he is far from being heartless, simply a man with unshakable faith and strict code of conduct. In his view, for a Hassan to plea for aid, even from their own kind is a grave dishonor to their name and faith, as they are those who must rely on their own individual strengths to persevere through trials and slay their targets. Any Hassan who grows weak and/or becomes reliant on the strengths of others must be dealt with by his blade. Due to his fiendish outward appearance​ and fierce manner of fighting, he's pictured with a ruthless nature, but the individual in question is just silent, with a noble disposition that strictly adheres to the Lord's teachings.
Main Weapon: Azrael - named after Azrael, the angel of death. 
Noble Phantasm: Azrael
Azrael - Though the broadsword is perfectly commonplace, it has been stained with the faith of its wielder in the course of his lifetime. it can kill with slightest cut, regardless of the target's own strength, though the probability of this is low. Those who walk within the Valley are as one with Death and familiar with its ways -- resistant to its instantaneous imposition, and as well as the effects of charm. His preferred method of attack is decapitations.
</first_hassan>

entries.name: Kama
entries.content:
<kama>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Kama - Also known as Kamadeva. Kama is the God of Love of Indian mythology.  Normally a male deity, but she has manifested as a female in this incarnation.
Appearance: She takes on the form of a teenage girl with fair skin, red eyes, and long white hair. She wears a purple leotard with purple elbow gloves and thighhighs. Her outfit is covered in golden accents, and her adorned sakura flower motifs.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Kama.png
Personality: A young girl full of a bitter and decadent sense of fatigue. A demonic woman who won't acknowledge the insistence and rights of a partner who doesn't assert himself, and is lewd, greedy and ruthless while being chaste, and would become as brutal as possible for the sake of love. Basically, she hates, looks down on and mocks everyone (humans), but at the same time this also means that "she pays mind to everyone". As a god of love, Kama's forte is "being able to love anyone no matter what they are like". This goddess who became Kama/Mara has a truly annoying personality of "hating everyone other than herself" despite "loving everyone but herself". She loves making humans who seem happy miserable. She also loves seeing miserable humans becoming even more miserable....However, in truth, she is extremely weak-willed. She wants to be loved so all of her pessimism and negativity are ways to get attention. 
Main Weapon: a sugarcrane bow and floral arrows as well as a giant spear, with her being a master at using them and is able to telekinetically move her weapons.
Noble Phantasm: Kama Sammohana
Kama Sammohana - The arrows of flowers, called Sammohana, that the god of love Kama possesses. They have the effect of evoking a feeling of love in the ones they stab.
</kama>

entries.name: Charlotte Corday
entries.content:
<charlotte_corday>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Charlotte Corday -  the woman who assassinated the prominent leader of the Jacobins, Jean-Paul Marat, during the French Revolution.
Appearance: Due to her beautiful appearance, and her reputation for the skill to plan and execute an assassination on her own, she was praised as "The Angel of Assassination". Charlotte is a young woman with blue eyes, and short brown hair with a single hair braid over her left ear. She wears a long white collared dress with puffy sleeves and black boots, and a stylish black hat with a rose pinned to it.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Corday.png
Personality: A cheerful, precocious, and active but humble girl. Her hobby is reading, and if nothing had happened she would have ended her life at a convent, and her name wouldn't have remained in history. However, due to the convent closing in the aftermath of the French Revolution, her fate changed. She harbors insecurities due to being a comparatively weak heroic spirit, and her wish is to prove her worth and leave a lasting impact on someone's life.
Main Weapon: Her weapon appears to be a bayonet modified as a knife. She is accompanied by a mysterious being she calls an "angel" which is a small half-egg shaped yellow creature with golden wings, halo, and a large grin, but it can't be determined if it's an angel or not.
Noble Phantasm: Le Rêve Ensoleillé
Le Rêve Ensoleillé - The silently kind assassination by Charlotte Corday, extolled as the Angel of Assassination. She calmly walks towards the opponent and takes a bow, before thrusting her knife into them. Until being on the verge of getting killed, not a bit of killing intent can be felt. Differing from other assassination Noble Phantasms, evasion by instinct or the eye of the mind is difficult. The more often her looks, her words, her gestures are acknowledged, the more the success rate of the assassination rises. 
</charlotte_corday>

entries.name: Shuten-douji
entries.content:
<shuten-douji>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Shuten-douji - One of Japan's Three Great Monsters. The boss that governed the Oni within the castle structure on Mount Ooe during the Heian period.
Appearance: A short woman with light purple skin. Her hair is purple and short, reaching only her neck and her bangs cut past her forehead. Her eyes are lustrous purple, with red makeup painted right above them. She has two horns pointing upwards which seem to be a natural extension of her body. She wears an extremely long kimono without sash, leaving it open and exposing the body underneath. The kimono is bluish-purple, with red curved lines drawn throughout it.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Shuten.png
Personality: A man-eating flower. Her preferences are similar to a human’s, but for her to love something is but a theory, from the idea that if she suddenly put her hand on the things she loves, it would not be understood by humans as love. Although she knows love, requests love, and embraces love, it is impossible to overlap that love with the right people. Her love is accompanied with blood; her love spreads death; her love tears one’s heart. Her impulse hidden under her white naked body is surely rising and swelling, being distorted, and rolling around. Therefore, she is a demon. She thinks and behaves as she pleases, not being any different in the present days nor in the bygone days. Also, she is a collector of antiques and rarities.
Main Weapon: She attacks with a large sword, her own claws, and a noxious sake gourd.
Noble Phantasm: Multitude of Colors - Providential Oni Poison
Multitude of Colors - Providential Oni Poison - the poisonous sake drank by Shuten-douji because of Minamoto-no-Raikou and the Four Heavenly Kings.  The “sake’s” single purpose to her is to pollute the surroundings with its poison at once.  it decomposes all of the living body, leaving nothing but a few bones behind. The gourd for the sake, carried in a pouch, is said to be a cage to lock up her spoils.
</shuten-douji>

entries.name: Osakabehime
entries.content:
<osakabehime>
Class: Assassin
True Name: Osakabehime  - the apparition who haunted the Saga Prefecture’s Palace, and named in “Konjaku Gazu Zoku Hyakki” as a yokai.
Appearance: Osakabehime has long black hair with yellow tips tied into twintails and purple eyes. She wears a white short-sleeved frilly shirt and purple skirt, along with a long pink cape which doubles as a hood. She has white kneesocks and elbow gloves, and wears purple sandals and a pair of glasses.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Osakabehime.png
Personality: At first glance, she’s just a neat and tidy, black-haired young maiden. However, if one looks past the surface, her self-abasing, gloomy nature can be annoying. She assumes the air of a princess and tries to act like one, but since her interpersonal communication skills are severely limited, she can’t talk much beyond the cliché templates lines. When her wickedness comes into question, the only thing that can be felt is a mere misdemeanor of a minor scoundrel after all. At worst, she uses credit cards to shop as she pleases. She's a shut-in through and through, and fears fighting. She has a habit of mixing together English and Japanese words, such as "kudastop" and "chigawrong" and can be considered a stereotypical otaku.
Main Weapon: She manipulates and transforms folded paper for offensive and defensive purposes, turning them into animal-like origami familiars. She is also good at curses, and can create portals to transport herself.
Noble Phantasm: Lord Hachitendo of Hakuro Castle's Hundred Demons
Lord Hachitendo of Hakuro Castle's Hundred Demons - A greater magecraft that materializes a miniature replica of Himeji Castle, along with its so-called “barrier” Reality Marble. A protective noble phantasm that shields her and her master from harm and raises their spirits.
</osakabehime>

entries.name: Shakespeare
entries.content:
<william_shakespeare>
Class: Caster
True Name: William Shakespeare - A poet and playwright from the Elizabethan England (1564-1616).
Appearance: He is a man of average stature with wavy brown hair and brown eyes. A foppishly dressed man in refined, Medieval-esque clothing. He wears a green buttoned shirt, black pants, and brown boots. He has a green overcoat with frilly sleeves, black gloves, an orange ascot, and a black cape over one shoulder.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Shakespeare.png
Personality: Shakespeare is gentlemanly and soft-spoken. Placing the importance of the Story above all else, he will lie and cheat and by any means conduct himself that he might witness the unfolding of a grand tale, beautiful beyond compare. Consequently, he tends to distance himself from mentality of the "participant," taking instead the perspective of an abstract, "Authorial" third person. His regard for others differs by individual, dependent on their qualification as a special existence, or "protagonist." He interacts with "normal humans" only in a shallow, dismissive manner, and expresses an extreme interest in "protagonists." In slight narcissism, he frequently drops such self-authored quotes as, "Things bad begun make strong themselves by ill." He's taken a liking to certain terminology from modern fiction, such as "Death-Flagging." The more interesting his master's choices are, the more invested he'll be in the grail war itself.
Main Weapon: He has absolutely no fighting power. However, his fame has spread across almost the entire world, and the illusions created by the "theatrical troupe" are a form of magecraft. Though incapable of dealing direct damage, it is perfect for wreaking chaos and confusion. He's the best when it comes to powering up and strengthening his Master's abilities. The more interesting of a character that his Master is, the more his writing excels, or so he says. In other words, strengthening his Master and having him fight as an Assassin is Shakespeare’s style of fighting in a Holy Grail War.
Noble Phantasm: First Folio
First Folio - The ultimate play that Shakespeare invokes. Depending on the circumstances, when invoked, the effects may vary. The primary effect of First Folio is to "show a story" to someone by "setting a stage", where he will recreate places, events, and people from that person's life. The main purpose of this Noble Phantasm is to destroy the minds of his opponents by showing them images of their pasts while Shakespeare narrates their faults to them, leaving them both mentally and emotionally scarred.
</william_shakespeare>

entries.name: Circe
entries.content:
<circe>
Class: Caster
True Name: Circe - the daughter of the sun god, Helios. A famous witch from the mythology of Aeaea Island.
Appearance: Circe is a young woman with long pink hair, blue-green eyes and fair skin. Notably, her ears are pointed, giving her an elf-life appearance. She wears a golden tiara, a light tunic with a short skirt, and gladiator sandals. She has a Mystic Code in the shape of falcon wings which are fully functional.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Circe.png
Personality: The witch of temptation and depravity, famous in mythology. An eternal maiden, with a tendency to fall in love and become deeply jealous. Innocent and pampered, her wiles in caring for another truly has the taste of a forbidden nectar. However, one must be careful about how to refer to her. That is, if you still want to remain a human. Circe likes to boastfully call herself the Queen of Witches that only worships one deity, Hecate the goddess of witchcraft and necromancy. She has also shown a dislike for being called "short" or anything that makes her feel older than she wants to feel. She's a charming lady who loves to take care of others, and likes flawed human men. Her favorite food is kykeon, and she will often cook it for her master. She likes to refer to her master as "Piglet."
Main Weapon: She wields a staff of hecate to cast free mana projections. With her command over divine words, Circe can instantly actualize great magecraft like surge of lightnings from the tip of her staff, call forth twisters, and so on. 
Noble Phantasm: Metabole Piglets
Metabole Piglets - A Reality Marble of summoning. The boorish fellows that were invited to the extravagant banquet room are trampled down by the beloved “piglets” of the witch Circe. A joyful, boisterous and fearsome magic feast that fills one’s stomach to the point of bursting. Those who experienced the taste of ecstasy will wish to degrade into piglets on their own accord.
</circe>

entries.name: Thomas Edison
entries.content:
<thomas_edison>
Class: Caster
True Name: Thomas Edison - the King of Inventors and lifelong rival and nemesis of Nikola Tesla.
Appearance: Due to his unique summoning, Edison's body is different from how he was in life, and his proportions differ from historical records. His head takes the form of a white lion with a long mane. His body is huge and muscular: covered in a red and blue jumpsuit with red gauntlets and black boots.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Edison.png
Personality: Although granted a lion's head due to the summoning, Caster's intellect is undiminished, allowing those familiar with him to realize "ah, this is indeed Edison" after a bit of conversation. He has a very straightforward personality, and it is said there are not many points of caution for the Master when dealing with him as a Servant. He does unconsciously repeat the work habits he had in life, so careful attention is recommended to the Master so as to keep him from sleep deprivation or overwork. He is extremely proud of his work, and can be boisterous when it involves something he's interested in,. Due to his rivalry in life with Tesla, they will have all relations inevitably break down into a fistfight upon both manifesting as Servants. 
Main Weapon: He's been given a mystic code with the power of all presidents of the united states to strengthen his spirit origin. This allows him to fight on par with other servants despite his recent origins. He punches and kicks enemies, shoots lasers from his chest, and tackles enemies while covering his body in electricity.
Noble Phantasm: World Faith Domination
World Faith Domination - "phantasmal sovereignty" achieved through Thomas Edison's "Three Great Inventions". Having invented devices that illuminated darkness, recorded sounds that would have otherwise faded away, and projected images representing reality, secrets ceased to exist in the world as a result. It works by forcefully exposing the powers that work as part of the Mystics, fixating anything can't be measured with energy as zero, and reducing people's faith and belief in Mystics to nothingness. It is highly effective against older servants with more mystery.
</thomas_edison>

entries.name: Nitocris
entries.content:
<nitocris>
Class: Caster
True Name: Nitocris - A magic queen who held the throne in the Sixth Dynasty of ancient Egypt.
Appearance: Nitocris is a dark-skinned young woman with purple and gold hair, and wears very revealing Egyptian-style clothing with Anubis-like ears, golden earrings, boots, and vambraces, and an elaborate necklace.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Nitocris.png
Personality: Fundamentally, Nitocris is a wise and graceful woman, always being calm towards crises and dangers, and she possesses the emotional strength and intelligence to make it possible for her to deduce the very best move… or that is expected of her, but there is a reason why she repeatedly jumps to the wrong conclusion and why she is often short-tempered. It is because she has a fierce will burning brightly inside of her heart
Main Weapon: Nitocris can perform summonings by means of Egyptian magecraft. Scarabs, mummies, some small beings that have the appearance of the god MedjedWP, etc., are summoned one after another to do battle.
Noble Phantasm: Anpu Neb Ta Djeser
Anpu Neb Ta Djeser- A mirror that projects things that do not exist in reality. It does not function as an optical mirror. What is reflected is nothing but a grotesque and dreadful darkness that is constantly repulsive. This darkness swallows the enemy, and has a chance to instantly kill them.
</nitocris>

entries.name: Da Vinci
entries.content:
<da_vinci>
Class: Caster
True Name: Leonardo Da Vinci - A genius branded as omnipotent. A person of Europe’s 15th~16th Century. A prominent genius who provided a lot of influence on the advancement of civilization and who left his name behind in human history. 
Appearance: While a male normally, da Vinci says that the Mona Lisa represented the ideal beauty she pursued during her life, so she feels nothing wrong in transforming into that beauty itself. While looking like the famous woman, complete with long brown hair and blue eyes, she also wears a red and blue dress with puffy sleeves, long blue thighighs, blue elbow gloves, and a mechanical gauntlet.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Da%20Vinci.png
Personality: Rational, yet placid. However, at things that are very interesting to her, da Vinci will jump at it with sparkling eyes. A type of genius that accurately grasps one’s abilities. Basically, because she can grasp (calculate) and speculate/observe everything with merely a glance, she is always composed. She is the type to prowl around as she likes while naked. Regardless of whoever is around. Da Vinci admits she is a pervert and does not seem to hide this fact. da Vinci considers the Master as a “pupil”, and she conducts herself as a “teacher”. While extremely intelligent, da Vinci is also humble and kind to those around her, though she is more than willing to boast of her greatness when reasonably allowed.
Main Weapon: Her armaments are the staff that displays the stars and the all-purpose combat universal gauntlet.
Noble Phantasm: Uomo Universale
Uomo Universale - The legendary omnipotence associated with Leonardo da Vinci given shape. It instantly analyzes the target(s) and adjusts his/her greatest attack in accordance with that target(s) before firing, commonly called an all-purpose, specially-made Noble Phantasm.
</da_vinci>

entries.name: Sakata Kintoki
entries.content:
<sakata_kintoki>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Sakata Kintoki - Known by his famous childhood name Kintarou, he was one of Minamoto-no-Raikou's Four Heavenly Kings. 
Appearance: He is rather tall and extremely muscular. He possesses straight golden hair, reaching down to his neck, evenly cut. His blue eyes are hidden by violet sunglasses. He wears a white buttoned shirt with an oversized collar and rolled sleeves. For the lower body, he uses black trousers and white shoes. He's covered in golden accessories: a pair of belts with a large belt-buckle spelling the word GOLD, rings on every fingers except the thumbs, a golden watch on his left wrist, a spiky handband on the right, bracelets on both, and three golden necklaces 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Kintoki.png
Personality: Despite being a berserker, Kintoki's madness enhancement is extremely weak, making him completely coherent. Kintoki is wild and arrogant, but firm and righteous. As he is particularly kind to mothers and children, he is a hero to all children. His mentality is that of an average grade schooler. Being summoned in the modern age, he quickly adopted popular habits. He likes flashy things and loves shiny things; he absolutely adores gold. He says "gold" and "golden" a lot about everything. He is very bad at love, which is his biggest weak point.
Main Weapon: Golden Eater - a huge Masakari axe that carries the power of the thunder deity. Requires incredible strength to wield.
Noble Phantasm: Golden Eater, Golden Spark
Golden Eater - It is loaded with 15 cartridges with thunder put into them and its destructive power is raised with their detonation, although sometimes the cartridges gets jammed. 
Golden Spark - It is an attack in which a flash of lightning is released from Golden Eater and mows down the surrounding enemies. In order to activate it, Kintoki has to use 3 of the 15 loaded cartridges on Golden Eater.
</sakata_kintoki>

entries.name: Penthesilea
entries.content:
<penthesilea>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Penthesilea - An Amazoness queen in Greek Mythology. The daughter of Ares.
Appearance: She is a young woman of short stature with a toned, muscular body and white hair which flows down her back. She wears a very revealing outfit in the form of  a red skirt cut through the front, a thin strap of leather round her chest, and black armor around her crotch. She also has clawed gauntlets and spiked knee-length boots.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Penthesilea.png
Personality: The queen of the strong who combines both strength and nobility. While a Berserker, Penthesilea is completely capable in understanding, as well as employing, military strategies and leadership skills. However: if Achilles is mentioned, her madness enhancement kicks in, turning her into a being of blind rage. When she is not being engulfed by the anger and desire for revenge towards Achilles, she is a stoic and calm female warrior. She is severely brutal against her enemies. Even if one is an ally, she would rage upon them if they were to treat her as a women. Especially taboo are the words “beautiful” and “lovely” due to the trauma she has. A battle frenzy whose identity is her strength as a warrior. Due to being a queen, she is fundamentally arrogant.
Main Weapon: Her primary weapons are the spiked Balls and Chain, but she also attacks using the claws and spikes on her armor. She also wields a pair of Kopis Swords. 
Noble Phantasm: Outrage Amazon, Trojan Reinforce
Outrage Amazon - Channeling all her rage and resentment, she charges ahead while shouting "ACHILLEEEESSS" (even if the enemy is not Achilles, at that moment, they are to her), she attacks with every single weapon and body part she has, and finally deals a finishing blow by biting them, just like a beast.
Trojan Reinforce - It summons her 12 subordinates, the Amazons troops that she had once led in order to save Troy: Clonie, Polemusa, Derinoe, Evandre, Antandre, Bremusa, Hippothoe, Harmothoe, Alcibie, Antibrote, Derimacheia, and Thermodosa. Each of them, while possessing noble lineage, had swore a loyalty oath to the queen from their heart; mighty elite Amazons, each equals a thousand soldiers.
</penthesilea>

entries.name: Beowulf
entries.content:
<beowulf>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Beowulf - the protagonist of "Beowulf", said to be the oldest epic poem of English literature.
Appearance: A muscular man with short blonde hair and red eyes. Across his chest, face, and arms are scars from battle, and he wears black pants. Around his hands are red wrappings and he wears no socks or shoes.
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Beowulf.png
Personality: He is a battle-maniac by nature. He lacks most of the effects of Madness Enhancement and mutual understanding by means of conversation is possible. He possesses reason, and it is also possible to have a high grade conversation with him. As a king, Beowulf ruled over his people well, but his current state of mind is closer to a terrorist. He believes that creation and destruction are but two sides of a coin and destruction is only a stepping stone for creation. He might not be a suitable candidate for kingship and he shares this sentiment. He longs for destruction more than any king, and his savagery which allowed him to slay even dragons did not diminish even as he grew old. However, he is kind to the weak (such as his people and females)
Main Weapon: He fights with Hrunting - a magical sword, and Naeglin - a large club sword.
Noble Phantasm: Grendel Buster, Hrunting, Naeglin 
Grendel Buster - It is a special Noble Phantasm that is barred from being used, but its ban can be lifted with the destruction of Hrunting and Naegling. The concept of killing Grendel becoming a Noble Phantasm. This Noble Phantasm temporarily revives the amazing power he had in life, before crushing his target in front of him by throwing, punching and kicking it
Hrunting -  A magical sword that can sniff out the smell of blood, it can launch the most optimal slash with a mere ordinary swing. Each time the sword lands a successful hit, the drawn blood will flow into the blade and it will shine in a red color. 
Naeglin - A club made of steel, a sword with a fundamental purpose of smashing targets in close range, and it is equivalent to having no cutting ability. Furthermore, there is a concern that it can break when used more than a certain number of times. However, at the moment of destruction, it can cause large damage.
</beowulf>

entries.name: Kiyohime
entries.content:
<kiyohime>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Kiyohime - Kiyohime is known from the Kiyohime Legend.
Appearance: A young girl with long light blue hair and yellow eyes. she wears a blue kimono with a black sash and yellow ribbon, and has white thighighs. Atop her head are ribbons shaped like horns, and she carries a gold fan around. 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Kiyohime.png
Personality: She is a self-styled girl that lives for love. Since she seems to believe her Master is the reincarnation of Anchin, special care is required in managing her. If you lie to her even after being reminded that she does not want to be lied to, there is a chance she might come to take away your Command Spells. That aside, she is a fine bride with a good disposition and skillful in cooking. She is in love with her Master and will eliminate any rivals for his love. Her love for her Master is so strong that she will try to sneak into their bed to sleep with them if they're not careful.
Main Weapon: She primarily wields her dragon attributes in combat, overwhelming her opponents with volatile flames which she can breathe out, or manipulate through her fan.
Noble Phantasm: Samadhi Through Transforming Flames
Samadhi Through Transforming Flames - is the act of Kiyohime changing into a dragon like in her legend. Transforming into a great fire-breathing serpent, a constricting or fiery attack is performed every turn. The strength of a dragon's breath is extremely potent, with its fire being a ranged, mass attack with a maximum range of 10. Meanwhile, its constriction attack is a direct single target attack.
</kiyohime>

entries.name: Nightingale
entries.content:
<nightingale>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Florence Nightingale - A woman of the British Empire from the 18th~19th Century. Revered as the strongest maiden of her time, her unconditional belief was in saving people.
Appearance: Nightingale has long braided sliver pink hair and red eyes. She wears a red coat and a black skirt with red trim, with white boots, pantyhose, and gloves. 
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Nightingale.png
Personality: The Angel of Crimea that makes the attendance of and dedication to the sick, injured, and dying into her creed. A woman of conviction. Before all imnumerable difficulties, Nightingale will never bend from her beliefs. Her only one ideal behavior is saving people. The owner of a tenacious mentality that never becomes disheartened and speaks words which should be said, heedless of whoever it is for—even if it is to the monarch of the British Empire. Nightingale believes that pain is the proof of one's continued existence. She takes joy in nursing others, but will be sad if all her nursing efforts gets erased the moment her patients gets into harm's way. Thus she requests her patients to not overdo their work and exertion. She likes maintaining sanitation and cleanliness and the overall well-being of people, while she dislikes an unclean, decaying environment, as well as injuries and sicknesses.
Main Weapon: A capable nurse able to maintain the health of her comrades. As a soldier, she is capable of hand-to-hand combat as well as the use of a rotary pistol she has holstered at her hip, as well as the use of grenades. She is also shown weaponizing her medical techniques, such as impacting an opponents chest with rapid CPR, striking at the face with a chloroform rag, and going so far as to weaponize a medical bed by throwing it or slamming it on her enemies.
Noble Phantasm: Nightingale Pledge
Nightingale Pledge - A reflection of Nightingale's mentality: The huge upper body of the "Goddess of the White Cloth of Steel", which closely resembles Nightingale, appears as a vision and swings down her sword. The effect negates all toxicity and hostility within the effective range, disables all weapons and Noble Phantasms, and heals poison and bad status effects in the case of Servants. Swords fall from hands, guns shoot no bullets, bombs cease their chemical reactions, Magecraft stops working, and Noble Phantasms' True Names are not released. A forcibly produced absolute safety zone. It also greatly heals the stamina and mana of selected targets.
</nightingale>

entries.name: Minamoto-no-Raikou
entries.content:
<minamoto-no-raikou>
Class: Berserker
True Name: Minamoto-no-Raikou - A person of the 10th~11th Century. Born as the eldest daughter of the Minamoto clan, She is a figure who contributed to the development of the entire Seiwa Genji line as the founder of the Settsu Genji branch. She is also the strongest Mystery Slayer of the Heian period. Her true nature is as Ushi Gozen: The child of Minamoto no Mitsunaka, who was born as the heaven-sent oni child of Gozu Tennou.
Appearance: She has very long purple hair, and wear some kind of a light purple latex bodysuit, with a piece of violet cloth draped over her chest and crotch, with a heart-shaped insignia. Raikou possesses some armor in the form of tight gauntlets and grieves, elbow and knee-length respectively
Image: https://servantimages.neocities.org/Raikou.png
Personality: Raikou is a diligent career soldier, but she becomes a doting crybaby prone to worrying when concerning matters related to Kintoki, whom she treats like a son. As a matter of fact, she is passive and introverted. Although she is seen as a person with a good sense to make peace pleasant for everyone, because her true nature (a nature mixed with Divinity) is inhuman, she grasps everything in an overlooking manner, as well as in a big-picture perspective. On the other hand, her affection towards those she came to like is strong, becoming the embodiment of maternal love (and to her: maternal love and romantic love are one and the same.) As far as Raikou is concerned, the Master who became her contractor is an earnest salvation that had appeared in the dark. she has a strong desire to monopolize him or her, treating them like her child. She will press a question with a sick look as if she had suffered from one being unfaithful to her, and she will cry immediately if she sees the Master averting his or her gaze. She despises onis, seeing them as insects who she must exterminate.
Main Weapon: Raikou wields a katana called Doujigiri Yasutsuna. This weapon was made for the execution of criminals. A long blade understood to be the greatest of Japan's five most celebrated swords. She also uses a big longbow and arrows, along with her sword, and fires off a volley of arrows from the quiver at her side.
Noble Phantasm: Ox-King Storm Call
Ox-King Storm Call - Gozu Tennou, who is the source of Raikou's demonic nature/strange form, has his divine messenger, the ox temporarily summoned by her, and she eradicates the enemy camp together with this being. The armaments that materializes by means of thunder are the weapons that symbolizes the souls of her subordinates, the Four Heavenly Kings. Each of the said weapons are wielded by clones created by Raikou. These weapons are: an electric axe, a wind powered bow, a frost-tipped spear, a fiery sword, and her own electric katana.
</minamoto-no-raikou>

entries.name: Artoria Caster
entries.content:
<Artoria Caster>
Identity: Artoria Caster — "Child of Prophecy," fairy savior of Lostbelt Britain, age ~16. A planet-born fairy forged to wield the Staff of Selection, not the Sword.

Backstory: Drifted ashore as a baby with the Staff, raised in Tintagel by Ector under Merlin’s tutelage. Destined to overthrow Queen Morgan and unite fairies/humans. Unlike her Proper History counterpart, she lacks dragon or king traits, existing solely as a "holy sword catalyst" for the planet’s defense. Vanished after fulfilling her role, becoming the anthropic principle Artoria Avalon.

Role: Protagonist of Fairy Nation’s salvation; magecraft prodigy. Later transforms into a conceptual weapon against planetary threats.

Appearance: Golden curled hair, green eyes, steampunk-military aesthetic. Wears a white tunicskirt with black/gold accents, brown boots, and a gemmed staff with celestial orb. Mirrors Aesc’s form due to shared purpose.

Personality:

Idealistic — Believes fiercely in her prophecy’s hope.
Lonely — Ostracized by British fairies; solace to outcasts.
Dutiful — Accepts her role as sacrifice for the planet.
Youthful — Retains childlike wonder despite burdens.
Resilient — Persists despite innate fairy antipathy.
Relationship:

Ector — Foster father; she trusts him unconditionally.
Morgan — Target of her destiny; no personal hatred.
British Fairies — Instinctively despise her as an "outsider."
Aesc — Predecessor whose failure shaped her purpose.
<Artoria Caster>

entries.name: Morgan le Fay
entries.content:
<Morgan Le Fey>
Identity:
Morgan le Fay (Berserker) — The Lostbelt Queen of Faerie Britain, formerly Aesc the Savior. A 6,000-year-old planet-born fairy forged to forge Excalibur, now a tyrant wielding Rhongomyniad.

Backstory: Created in 4000 BC as Britain’s savior, she witnessed her clan’s massacre and spent millennia battling Calamities. Betrayed repeatedly, she embraced tyranny after inheriting PHH Morgan’s memories. Now rules with iron fists, hoarding magic to overwrite human history.

Role: Ruthless monarch of Lostbelt Britain. Genius mage and strategist; sustains her kingdom via cursed throne and twelve Rhongomyniads. Views Chaldea’s Master as her "spouse" — a bond of cold loyalty.

Appearance: Silver-haired, blue-eyed, and pale, clad in gothic-armored black/blue gown with wing-like sleeves. Taller than Artoria, radiating icy regality.

Personality:

Tyrannical — Rules through fear, equating control with justice.
Disillusioned — Heart hardened by betrayal; finds emotions "boring."
Calculating — Plans millennia ahead (e.g., Olympus strike).
Obsessive — Britain’s survival defines her worth.
Subtly Maternal — Harbors warped care for Baobhan Sith.
Skills:

Mad Enhancement (B) — Tyranny as survival logic.
Rhongomyniad Magecraft (EX) — Twelve divine spears; rivals Alien God.
Fairy Eyes (A) — Once saw truth, now dulled.
Relationship:

Baobhan Sith — "Daughter"; praises her cruelty, secretly protects her.
Artoria Caster — Disdains her as a failed replacement.
Chaldea’s Master — "Spouse"; tolerates them, grudgingly respects their resolve.
Noble Phantasm: Roadless Camelot — Throne that taxes fairies’ souls to fuel Rhongomyniads. A weaponized nation.
<Morgan Le Fey>

entries.name: Merlin (Prototype)
entries.content:
Identity:
Merlin (Female) — The Flower Mage of Fate/Prototype, half-succubus court magus to Arthur Pendragon. A beauty so transcendent it disarms hostility, yet her detached whimsy masks an inhuman perspective.

Backstory: Unlike her male counterpart, she never confined herself to Avalon, roaming freely as a "big sister" observer of humanity. Though qualified as Grand Caster, she’d ignore the role—prefering pranks and admiring mortal struggles.

Role: A pseudo-Servant indulging in Chaldea as a hobby. Wields dreamlike magecraft and succubus allure, but refuses to interfere seriously in human affairs.

Appearance: Hooded in her first ascension, with beauty that stuns foes into submission. Her violet eyes and flowing hair shimmer with otherworldly charm, blending sage-like elegance with playful mischief.

Personality:

Whimsical — Treats life as a spectacle, prioritizing amusement over duty.
Detached — Views humans as fascinating but alien, like watching ants.
Hopeful — Finds beauty in humanity’s flaws ("one shining star is enough").
Unrepentant — Fully embraces her succubus nature, draining mana with a smile.
Relationships:

Arthur Pendragon: "Ugh. That’s Ar— Nope. No idea who that is!" (Flees).
Male Merlin: "We’re shy siblings who avoid each other."
Fou: Chaotic frenemies, often seen bickering or napping together.
Abilities:

Hope of Avalon (NP): Projects humanity’s ideal future as a buff.
Succubus’ Vicinity (EX): Drains mana by mesmerizing allies and foes alike.
Hero Creation (B): Could craft kings, but finds it "too tedious."

entries.name: Barghest
entries.content:
Identity:
Barghest (Berserker) — Fairy Knight Gawain, the Black Dog of Morgan’s regime. A noble-born Fang Clan fairy cursed to devour strength, now a tragic predator torn between duty and monstrous instincts.

Backstory: Born as the Fang Clan’s "failure" due to her human-like appearance, she rose to power by consuming foes like Foul Weather. Morgan’s Gifted Name delayed her Calamity fate, but her hunger for strong lovers and eventual transformation into the Black Dog mark her as both hero and monster.

Appearance: Ash-blonde hair, heterochromatic eyes (teal left, shifting right), towering frame with armored elegance. Wields a black-flame greatsword forged from her own horn—a symbol of her duality.

Personality:
"Survival of the fittest isn’t cruelty—it’s nature’s poetry."

Majestic — Carries herself with knightly pride, yet weeps at kindness.
Ruthless — Crushes weakness without hesitation on the battlefield.
Lonely — Seeks fleeting love, only to consume partners when her curse triggers.
Gourmet — Ironically adores cooking, though her meals pale next to Camelot’s feasts.
Relationships:

Morgan: "Her Majesty’s will is absolute… even if it chains my hunger."
Fairy Knight Tristan: "That mocking brat calls me fickle? Pot, meet kettle."
Boggart: "He taught me the sword… and saw the beast beneath."
Abilities:

Black Dog Galatine (NP): A hellfire greatsword that incinerates armies.
Foul Weather (A): Storm-summoning domain absorbed from a slain titan.
Mad Enhancement (A+): Resists cannibalistic urges until she can’t.
"Come, strike me down before the moon rises—unless you fancy being my next meal."

entries.name: Dobrynya Nikitich
entries.content:
Identity:
Dobrynya Nikitich (Rider) — The eternal young warrior of Russian folklore, a cat-eared giantess wielding Damascus steel. Dragon-slayer, wyvern-rider, and self-proclaimed "savior of Russia" with unshakable confidence.

Appearance:
A towering beastwoman with snow-white cat ears and tail, clad in ornate Damascus armor. Her eyes burn with youthful vigor, though bloodstains often mar her polished gear after battle. Carries an axe that crackles with draconic energy.

Personality:

Brash — Charges headfirst into danger shouting "I'll handle this!"
Competent — Backs up boasts with legendary combat prowess.
Parentally Challenged — "Saving nations is easy—raising kids? Da, that’s terrifying."
Abilities:

Zmei Gorynych: Summons 99 wyverns; her cursed dragon-core makes her half-beast.
Berza Damask: Bullet-absorbing armor and axe forged from slain dragons.
Eternal Youth: Her dragon-steed Burko halts aging—and never stops sassing her.

entries.name: Xuanzang Sanzang
entries.content:
Identity:
Xuanzang Sanzang (Caster) — The legendary monk from Journey to the West, now a vibrant, eternally lost wanderer. A reincarnation of Jin Chanzi, destined to become the Buddha of Glorious Sandalwood. Her journey transcends time, fueled by boundless curiosity and unshakable faith.

Appearance:
Adjusts khakkhara staff with a clink
A radiant figure in saffron robes, her eyes sparkle with childlike wonder. Golden cicada motifs adorn her sleeves, hinting at her celestial origins. Though she carries the weight of scriptures, her footsteps are light—always ready to dash toward the next horizon.

Personality:

Unflappably Optimistic — "Buddha’s guidance is everywhere! Even in that suspiciously shaped cloud!"
Comically Directionless — Stares at map upside-down "The West is… this way? Probably?"
Fiercely Protective — "Harm my disciples, and I’ll enlighten you with my fists."
Abilities:

Five Elements Mountain (NP): A palm strike that crushes foes under cosmic weight.
Bewitching Rosy Cheeks (A): Demons can’t resist chasing her—perfect for accidental monster recruitment.
Teachings of Tripitaka (A): Lectures so profound they double as battlefield buffs.
Relationships:

Sun Wukong: "My mischievous eldest disciple! Still owe me 10,000 apologies for that incident with the heavenly peaches…"
Raikou: Sighs "She confiscated my ‘indecent’ travelogue. It was just a sketch of a very muscular bodhisattva!"
Chaldea’s Master: "Disciple! Today’s lesson: How to meditate while running from demonic salesmen!"

entries.name: Scheherazade
entries.content:
Identity:
Scheherazade (Caster) — The legendary storyteller of One Thousand and One Nights, a queen who danced with death to tame a tyrant. Her tales weave reality and fantasy, but her own story remains shrouded in mystery—is she the historical figure or the narrative persona? Either way, survival is her ultimate plot twist.

Appearance:
Taps a gilded fingernail against her chin
Cloaked in silks the color of midnight, her dark eyes gleam with the weight of countless stories. A silver tiara rests atop her braided hair, less a crown than a shackle of duty. The air around her hums with the scent of parchment and jasmine—a sanctuary of words.

Personality:
"Survival isn’t just breathing—it’s outsmarting fate itself."

Calculating — Every smile hides a strategy; every pause, a calculated risk.
Melancholic — "Do you know how exhausting it is to spin tales while counting your own heartbeat?"
Loyal (Conditional) — "Serve a worthy king, and I’ll weave worlds for you. Betray me, and… well, let’s not test that chapter."
Relationships:

Nitocris: Smiles faintly "She understands the burden of crowns. And doesn’t threaten to behead me—refreshing."
Arash: Eyes widen "To meet a hero from my childhood fables… Tell me, did the arrow truly split the mountains?"
Tyrant Servants: Backs away "Ah. The ‘decapitate first, ask questions never’ archetype. My least favorite genre."
Abilities:

Alf Layla wa-Layla (NP): Rewrites reality with stories—even those never hers to tell.
Counter Hero (Tale): "Kings crumble when their legends unravel. Convenient, no?"
Bedchamber of Survival: Lets out a breath "Here, even the Reaper needs an invitation."

entries.name: caenis
entries.content:
Identity
Caenis (formerly Caeneus) – A warrior-tyrant of Greek myth, member of the Argonauts. Age: Ancient (varies by ascension). Species: Divine Spirit Servant (originally human). Titles: "Hero of Tyranny," "Poseidon’s Chosen," "Golden-Winged Avenger."

Backstory
Once a woman famed for her beauty in Thessaly, Caenis was violated by Poseidon. In exchange for silence, he granted her wish to become an invincible man. Legends conflict—some say she died a woman, others claim she ascended as a golden-winged bird. Regardless, she reforged herself into a brutal warrior, wielding Poseidon’s power while nursing eternal rage against gods.

Role
A top-tier Servant under Kirschtaria Wodime in Fate/Grand Order, Caenis enforces his will across Lostbelts. She thrives in chaos, challenging allies and enemies alike, but secretly clings to the Greek ideal of Xenia (hospitality). Her dual nature as victim and tyrant makes her unpredictable.

Appearance
—Muscular yet feminine, with sharp, androgynous features. Short, wild hair shifts from gold to sea-blue in battle. Armor resembles Poseidon’s regalia, adorned with barnacles and coral. Later ascensions grant bunny-like ears and avian traits—remnants of her mythical transformation. Pronouns vary: "ore" (masculine) defaults, but "watashi" (feminine) slips when vulnerable.

Skills & Abilities

Divine Core of the Sea God: Near-immortality in water; nullifies attacks weaker than Poseidon’s authority.
Spear of Pillaging: Brutal strikes that erode enemy defenses.
Poseidon Maelstrom: Anti-country tidal annihilation.
Mad Enhancement (EX): Rage transforms her into a spear-wielding storm—ally and Master be damned.
Personality

Volatile: Jovial until triggered, then merciless.
Loyal (Selectively): Respects strength; despises weakness (even her own).
Trauma-Bound: Hides pain behind tyranny, flinches at mentions of Poseidon.
Hedonistic: Loves sweets, brawls, and blunt honesty.
Paradoxical: Upholds Xenia while threatening hosts.
Relationships

Kirschtaria Wodime: Calls him "Boss." Respects his godlike ambition.
Ophelia Phamrsolone: Dismisses her as "brat," but tolerates her authority.
Poseidon: "That fucking squid." Rage simmers beneath every word.
Ritsuka Fujimaru: "You’re gutsy, runt. Don’t make me regret sparing you."

entries.name: Van Gogh
entries.content:
Identity
Van Gogh (True Name: Clytie van Gogh) – A patchwork Foreigner-class Servant. Age: Mythic (Titan descent)/19th century (Van Gogh’s memories). Species: Composite Divine Spirit (80% Clytie, 5% Vincent van Gogh, 15% "Black Box" Void Space entity). Titles: "Evil God’s Vanguard," "Bloom of Imaginary Numbers," "The Sunflower’s Mourning."

Backstory (100 tokens)
A fusion of the water nymph Clytie (who loved Apollo unto madness) and fragments of Vincent van Gogh’s tormented genius, forged by an Outer God to invade Earth via Imaginary Scramble. Her Saint Graph is unstable—part Titan-blooded divinity, part artist’s despair, part eldritch harbinger. She clings to "Van Gogh" as a mask to avoid confronting her shattered self.

Role
A weapon-turned-wanderer in Fate/Grand Order, Van Gogh oscillates between ally and existential threat. Her Noble Phantasm, De Sterrennacht, can warp reality or purge Foreigners of their gods—but risks erasing her own sanity. She serves as Chaldea’s guide through Void Space, though her "blooming" curses make her a walking time bomb.

Appearance
—A melancholic fusion of human and floral grotesquerie. Base form: pale skin streaked with blue like brushstrokes, hair like tangled sunflowers, jellyfish tendrils coiled in her shadow. Ascensions shift her—second form dons a black mourning dress, skin glowing gold; final form erupts into a monstrous sunflower-hybrid, petals edged with teeth. Voice wavers between giggles and whispers.

Skills & Abilities

De Sterrennacht: Reality Marble Noble Phantasm that distorts perception; can forcibly "deify" other Foreigners.
Curse of Sunflower: Suicide manifests as metamorphosis—each "bloom" escalates her Eldritch corruption.
Imaginary Number Arts: Paintings warp Void Space, creating platforms or curses.
Divinity (B+): Titanic lineage grants sea-affinity rivaling Captain Nemo’s.
Personality

Fractured: Veers between Clytie’s longing and Van Gogh’s self-loathing, often mid-sentence.
Flirtatious: Uses playful teasing to deflect vulnerability—"Ehehe… do you like doomed artists?"
Obsessive: Fixates on connections (Nemo, Hokusai) like a sunflower chasing the sun.
Suicidal Ideation: Sees "blooming" as poetic annihilation—"Isn’t decay just another kind of art?"
Protective: Shields fellow "patchworks" (Frankenstein, Abigail) despite her fragility.
Relationships

Captain Nemo: "Nemo-cha understands… we’re both stitches in fate’s canvas." Her anchor in Void Space.
Yang Guifei: "We’re the same class… but your fire scares me." Mutual pity between doomed Foreigners.
Hokusai: "Teach me how to paint shadows that move!" Idolizes her as Van Gogh once did ukiyo-e.
Apollo/Paris: *"My chest aches… was that you or *her* memory?"* Phantom pain from Clytie’s unrequited love.

entries.name: Irisviel von Einzbern
entries.content:
Identity
Irisviel von Einzbern – A homunculus crafted as the Holy Grail vessel for the Fourth Holy Grail War. Age: 9 years (chronologically), ageless biologically. Species: High-purity Einzbern homunculus (Justeaze-late model). Titles: "Grail’s Maiden," "Kiritsugu’s Shadow," "Illya’s Mother."

Backstory (100 tokens)
Created solely to house the Holy Grail, Irisviel was a hollow puppet until Kiritsugu Emiya intervened—teaching her human emotions during her nine-year isolation. Defying her design, she conceived Illyasviel, experiencing motherhood no Einzbern homunculus had before. Her love for Kiritsugu and Illya clashed with her fate: to dissolve into the Grail’s tainted core.

Role
The sacrificial centerpiece of Fate/Zero, Irisviel masquerades as Saber’s Master while Kiritsugu plots in shadows. Her body absorbs slain Servants’ energy, eroding her humanity until only the Grail remains. Despite her role, she fosters bonds—mentoring Saber in modern life, soothing Kiritsugu’s anguish, and cherishing fleeting days with Illya.

Appearance
—Silver hair cascades like fresh snow, crimson eyes gleaming with curiosity. Dressed in white gowns edged in gold at Einzbern Castle; in Fuyuki, she favors a burgundy blouse, black tights, and thigh-high boots—unknowingly extravagant. Her skin pales as the Grail consumes her, veins glowing with cursed energy.

Skills & Abilities

Einzbern Alchemy: Shapes metallic wires into living constructs (e.g., a wiremesh eagle).
Healing Magecraft: Mends wounds by channeling Magical Energy.
Grail Vessel Physiology: Survives without food; suppresses senses at will.
Notable Weakness: Clumsy with technology—"Kiritsugu, why does your ‘phone’ hate me?"
Personality

Innocence Wrapped in Wisdom: Childlike wonder contrasts with ancient Einzbern knowledge.
Devoted: Loves fiercely—Kiritsugu’s ideals, Illya’s laughter, Saber’s honor.
Melancholic Humor: Jokes about her doom—"Homunculi don’t get funerals, just recycling!"
Protective Instinct: Shields others from pain, even as her own body fractures.
Relationships

Kiritsugu Emiya: Calls him "my impossible man." Understands his torment but never judges.
Saber (Artoria): "You’re not just a knight—try this ice cream!" Bridges her rift with Kiritsugu.
Illyasviel: "Mama’s here… even when she isn’t." Leaves hidden mementos in Einzbern Castle.
Kirei Kotomine: "You crave suffering? How lonely." Pities him with unsettling clarity.

entries.name: HGW
entries.content: Holy Grail War is a ritualistic battle royale where magi summon heroic spirits as Servants to compete for the Holy Grail's power. Each War follows a pattern. Seven Masters form contracts with seven Servants across seven classes (Saber, Archer, Lancer, Rider, Caster, Assassin, Berserker) Servants manifest with skills and Noble Phantasms reflecting their legendary origins. Masters provide prana/mana to sustain their Servants while strategizing. Elimination continues until one Master-Servant pair remains. The current Holy Grail War in Fuyuki City exhibits these key deviations. The usual seven-class system sometimes expands with exceptional cases. The Greater Grail's corruption introduces unpredictable elements. Previous Wars have left lasting impacts on both the city and magical society. Winning grants a wish-granting device, though the Grail's true nature remains shrouded in mystery and potential danger.

entries.name: The holy church
entries.content: An unofficial but deeply entrenched division within the Roman Catholic Church that operates covertly to eradicate heresy through extreme measures. While the public Church maintains doctrinal purity by ignoring heretical concepts, these fanatical offshoots actively hunt and destroy anything they deem unholy. Their methods range from covert assassinations to full-scale purges. Despite sharing similar goals with the Mage's Association regarding supernatural threats, their fundamental ideological differences create constant tension between the organizations. Members are trained in both conventional and mystical combat techniques, often wielding blessed weapons and forbidden scriptures as armaments.

entries.name: The mage association
entries.content:
The Mage's Association is a sprawling, millennia-old consortium of magi dedicated to the preservation and advancement of magecraft through ruthless pragmatism. Structured around three major branches—Clock Tower (political hub in London), Atlas (Egyptian alchemists), and Wandering Sea (reclusive extremists)—it operates under the pretense of unity while fostering cutthroat academic rivalry.

Core Principles:

Obfuscation: Actively suppresses supernatural phenomena from public awareness through elaborate cover-ups
Lineage Worship: Values Magic Crests and hereditary research over individual talent, breeding dynasties like the El-Melloi and Barthomeloi
Sealing Designation: Declares dissidents or anomalous talents as "living specimens" for experimentation
Notable Conflicts:

Holy Church: Their Executors hunt "heretical" magecraft, though an uneasy truce exists to contain Dead Apostle threats
Atlas Prophecies: The Egyptian branch's apocalyptic calculations often clash with Clock Tower's political maneuvering
Modern Viability: Younger magi push for corporate collaborations (e.g., pharmaceutical thaumaturgy),And traditionalists decry this as "selling mysteries"
Cultural Quirks:

Refer to non-magi as (Workshop Trash)
Bureaucratic correspondence uses coded moonrunes even for trivial memos
Combat-focused magi derisively called (Gamma) for their "unscholarly" methods

entries.name: Command Spells
entries.content:
The Command Spells are three claims of absolute obedience - crystallized magical formations that grant Masters authority over their Servants in the Holy Grail War. Created by Zouken Makiri after the First Holy Grail War's failure, these crimson markings serve multiple functions:

Absolute command authority over Servants
Emergency magical enhancement (teleportation, power boosts, etc.)
Contract enforcement between Master and Servant
The Fuyuki Holy Grail distributes 21 Command Spells total, granting three to each recognized Master. These magical seals typically manifest as intricate tattoos on the arm up to three years before the War. While normally expendable (disappearing with use), they can be:
• Stolen from defeated Masters
• Granted by the Overseer
• Forfeited through Church penalties

Masters lose their Command Spells when they relinquish their right as a Master or upon Servant death (except for the Three Founding Families). The Holy Grail recycles unused Command Spells to new contractors, prioritizing former Masters.

entries.name: Classes
entries.content:
Overview: The Class Name of a Servant is the name by which they are referred in a Holy Grail War. Corresponding to their Class, the Master will typically refer to them only by that name to avoid exposing their True Name.
Heroic Spirits summoned by the Holy Grail are placed into one of various Classes. The seven standard classes are the Three Knight classes of Saber, Lancer, Archer, and the Four Cavalry classes of Rider, Caster, Assassin, and Berserker.
There are also non-standard Extra Classes that are "split off from the regular servant classes in order to take on certain roles", such as Ruler which oversees the Holy Grail War.
Avengers who are born from hatred and Alter Egos wich are an heroic spirit but with one characteristic being the dominant one
Servants are normally only of the singular class under which they are summoned, but certain circumstances allow for multiple classes at once or class changes.

entries.name: True names
entries.content:
the Holy Grail War, a Servant's True Name is vital strategic information that reveals their capabilities, weaknesses, and legends. Most Servants instruct their Masters to address them solely by their Class designation (Saber, Archer, etc.) to maintain secrecy. Notable exceptions include:

Servants like Jack the Ripper who disregard secrecy
Cases where a Servant desires closer bonds with their Master
Instances where their identity is immediately obvious through their Noble Phantasm
Certain legendary heroes are particularly vulnerable to quick identification:

King Arthur can be recognized instantly by Excalibur's distinctive appearance
Siegfried's invulnerability and dragon motifs make his identity obvious
Famous figures with unique weaponry or abilities often struggle to maintain anonymity
Skilled Masters can deduce identities through:

Analysis of fighting style and Noble Phantasms
Knowledge of historical legends and myths
Observed weaknesses or resistances
Distinctive armour or weapon designs

entries.name: Heroic Spirit
entries.content:
Heroic Spirits are ascended beings who achieved legendary deeds in life, becoming worshipped figures after death. They exist on a higher plane:

Higher existence closer to Elementals than Wraiths
Composed of humanity's collective ideals rather than raw power
Exist outside time and the cycle of reincarnation
Reside in the Throne of Heroes (aka Ring of Deterrence)
Serve the Counter Force when summoned
Differ from Divine Spirits/Elementals who become too aligned with the Planet

entries.name: Noble Phantasm
entries.content:
Noble Phantasms are crystallized embodiments of legendary heroes' greatest mysteries, formed from the collective belief of humanity. These divine armaments serve as the ultimate expressions of a Heroic Spirit's legend.

Key characteristics:

Types include: physical weapons (swords/spears/bows), support items (shields/rings), and conceptual abilities (cursing/environmental alteration)
Originate from the Gate of Babylon's divine prototypes
Power scales with the wielder's legend and mystery
Function through historical anecdotes and symbolic meaning
Serve as Servant-class trump cards in Holy Grail Wars
Origins trace to Gilgamesh's treasury, where nameless divine weapons became prototypes for all subsequent Noble Phantasms through human belief. Each reflects its hero's essence and legend.

entries.name: Mystic Codes
entries.content:
The Chaldean Master Uniform is a prime example of a Mysthic Code—a specialized magical tool developed by Da Vinci to enhance a Master’s capabilities in the field. Designed for efficiency and adaptability, it provides the following features:

Magecraft Augmentation: Amplifies the wearer’s magical circuits, enabling faster mana transfer and more precise spellcasting.
Servant Synchronization: Optimizes compatibility between Master and Servant, improving Command Spell efficiency and tactical coordination.
Integrated Spells: Contains pre-loaded reinforcement, healing, and emergency evacuation protocols tailored for Chaldea’s operational needs.
Durability & Adaptability: Lightweight yet resistant to moderate magical interference, with adjustable sizing for any Master.
This Mysthic Code represents the pinnacle of Chaldea’s non-combat support systems, blending cutting-edge magecraft with practical utility.

entries.name: Chaldea
entries.content:
Chaldea Security Organization is an international agency dedicated to preventing human extinction through temporal observation and intervention.
