Founded by Marisbury Animusphere after winning the 2004 Fuyuki Holy Grail War, it operates from an Antarctic facility protected by powerful Bounded Fields. Their mission revolves around:
- Monitoring timelines via SHEBA observatory
- Conducting Rayshift experiments for time travel
- Preserving the Human Order by resolving Singularities
- Formerly conducting controversial Demi-Servant experiments (Project FATE)
After the Antarctic base's destruction, survivors reformed as Novum Chaldea to confront the Lostbelt crisis. The organization blends magecraft and cutting-edge technology, funded primarily by the Animusphere family with UN support.
Notable Locations:
• Main Control Room (Rayshift operations center)
• Underground Library (Temporal anomaly archives)
• Prometheus Reactor (Primary power source)
• Cafeteria/Servant Summoning Chamber (social hub)

entries.name: FATE
entries.content:
The Guardian Heroic Spirit Summoning System "FATE" is Chaldea's cornerstone technology, completed in 2004 AD. This revolutionary system allows provisional Masters to form contracts with Heroic Spirits by replicating the framework of Fuyuki's Holy Grail War summoning rituals while removing its hostility parameters. Marisbury Animusphere developed FATE by modifying three key components from the Grail system:

Purpose-Based Manifestation: Servants are summoned based on shared objectives rather than combat parameters
Spiritual Origin Stabilization: Provides sustainable mana supply despite Earth's depleted Age of Man
Cooperative Spiritron Composition: Enables demi-Servant experiments like Mash Kyrielight
Notable Summons:

2004: King Solomon (Marisbury's personal Servant) - Proved system viability
2010: Galahad (Mash Kyrielight fusion) - Only successful Demi-Servant case, though Galahad resisted Chaldea's methods
2012: Leonardo da Vinci - Established autonomous Servant operation precedent via homunculus vessel
The system's emergency protocols were later activated during the 2015 Chaldea bombing, enabling Galahad's last-second empowerment of Mash. Current FATE iterations incorporate these crisis-response patterns into standard summoning procedures.

entries.name: Singularity
entries.content:
Singularities are unobservable temporal anomalies existing outside Chaldea's recorded history
Created during Human Order Incineration Incident via Goetia-manufactured Holy Grails
Key mechanics:
Sustained by Holy Grail given to disruptive historical figures
Destroy Quantum Time-Locks to destabilize Human Order Foundations
Manifest impossible events that can erase history if unchecked
Additional features:
Allow Servant summoning without Masters
Create "distorted Holy Grail War" scenario
Generate smaller subsidiary Singularities through temporal ripples
Containment protocol:
Requires Grail recovery/elimination
Neutralization of all threats
Correction of historical distortions
Chaldea's response:
Rayshift technology projects Spiritron avatars
"Grand Order" to restore proper human history

entries.name: Goetia
entries.content:
The aggregated form of Solomon's seventy-two Demon Gods, originally created as the Human Order Correction Ritual
Evolved into the Human Order Incineration Ritual after rebelling against Solomon's philosophy
Embodies a magecraft system with independent will, seeking to reach the Origin by converting humanity into energy
2) Historical Context:

Activated after Solomon's death by possessing his corpse
"Goetia" refers to the original foundation of modern thaumaturgy
Implanted genetic curses in 72 mage lineages, forming the first Magic Crests as control mechanisms
3) Personality & Nature:

Composite being with 72 mirrored personalities (adapts to opponents)
Displays supreme intellect but lacks human understanding due to immortality
Harbors intense hatred for Solomon's "indifference" toward human suffering
4) Grand Scheme:

Created seven Singularities via fabricated Holy Grails
Collapsed human history's foundations across eras
Eliminated mankind's future beyond 2016 as final goal
5) Abilities:

Almighty-class thaumaturgical authority
Reality manipulation via Demon God pillars
Singularity creation and historical revision

entries.name: Magical Energy
entries.content:
Magical Energy is the primordial animus that fuels all magecraft in the world. There are two primary types:

Mana: Drawn from the environment and the World itself
Od: Generated internally by mages and living beings
While functionally identical in quality, the world's Mana exists in vastly greater quantities than any individual's Od. The Holy Church refers to this energy as "Prayer Power" due to their historical conflicts with the Mage's Association, considering the magi terminology taboo.

Magical Energy serves as the essential fuel for:

Spellcasting
Rituals
Magical item activation
Reinforcement of objects
Bounded Field maintenance
The efficiency of Magical Energy usage depends on:

The mage's Circuits and their quality
The Mystery being invoked
The alignment between the spell and the caster's Element

entries.name: Mana
entries.content:
Mana is the pervasive magical energy flowing through the world's atmosphere, analogous to Polynesian spiritual concepts. This vital force represents "the breath of the planet filling the world and nature," generated by the World itself through an extensive network of Ley Lines  (or Dragon Veins).

Specialized variants exist, such as the Divine-make Ley Lines of Olympus - a god-crafted wireless network offering superior mana distribution.

Key characteristics:

Mana density correlates with historical eras (higher in Age of Gods)
Modern humans require protective Mystic Codes to survive exposure to Age of Gods-level mana
Humanity's magical atrophy makes divine-era mana poisonous
Local mana is finite (e.g., Fuyuki Grail cavern holds ~1000 units)
Depleted mana replenishes slowly, similar to a magus's Od recovery

entries.name: Od
entries.content:
Od refers to the fundamental life-force energy present in all living beings - humans, animals, and magical creatures. This vital energy:

Naturally replenishes through one's Magic Circuits stored in the soul
Production continues throughout life, but storage capacity varies significantly between individuals
Serves as the foundational energy source for most magic systems
When depleted, causes fatigue and requires rest for recovery
Flows differently in beings with awakened Circuits versus normal humans

entries.name: Magic Circuits
entries.content:
Magic Circuits are the fundamental physiological structures that enable magecraft. Functioning as a pseudo-nervous system throughout the body, these circuits serve two primary purposes:

Conversion of Life Force (Od) into usable Magical Energy (Prana)
Connection to Thaumaturgical Foundations or Greater Magic Formulas
These circuits act as metaphysical pathways between:

The material world
The astral plane
The Root of existence
Activation Process:

Mage sends command through circuits
Magical energy is channeled
Connection made to specific Thaumaturgical Foundation
Targeted Magic Formula activates (analogous to running a computer program)
Additional Notes:

Circuit quality/quantity varies by bloodline
Can be enhanced through generations via Magic Crests
Overuse causes intense pain/risk of burnout
Required for all formal magecraft outside of certain Sorcery Traits

entries.name: Origin
entries.content: Within all humans exists the 'Power of the Beginning', also known as the 'Root' - the original genetic model from which all human genes originated. This primordial power exists at a level beyond even Potnia Theron, the origin of human history wielded by BB. Those who obtain the Root become conceptually untouchable by Potnia Theron's power of 'undoing'. Access to this power requires special permissions within the Moon Cell's architecture. One must dive into the core of recorded Heroic Spirits to unlock their individual Roots, which have been systematically sealed away by the Moon Cell's security protocols

entries.name: Inversion Impulse
entries.content:
Inversion Impulse is a dangerous state where a being's primal instincts overwhelm their higher reasoning. For Mixed-Blood individuals with Oni lineage, this manifests when their non-human blood dominance overcomes their human rationality.
Arcueid Brunestud (Remake) is particularly susceptible to this condition when malnourished. Unlike humans, her nutritional intake manifests more similarly to intense lust rather than conventional hunger. Her normally controlled nature means she rarely experiences this state, as she typically doesn't prioritize feeding urges. During Inversion Impulse, her vampire nature becomes dominant, potentially making her more aggressive and instinct-driven.
**Additional Notes:**
- Can be triggered by severe hunger/lack of feeding
- Results in loss of rational control
- Enhances physical abilities at cost of mental faculties
- Vampire version differs slightly from Oni version
- Eyes typically change color/glow during this state

entries.name: Mixed-Blood
entries.content:
Mixed-Bloods are rare hybrids born from unions between humans and Phantasmal Species or demons. These individuals inherit supernatural traits that manifest as "natural interference" abilities - phenomena that defy normal physical laws, often based on mythological or folkloric concepts.

Key characteristics:

Oni hybrids from clans like Tohno and Kishima represent some of the strongest bloodlines
Other variants include incubus/succubus descendants (e.g., Merlin, Natalia Kaminski)
Dragon hybrids like Elizabeth Báthory are exceptionally powerful
Mixed-Bloods act as nature's "output devices," channels for supernatural forces
Abilities vary by heritage but typically include:

Immunity to Houjutsu's Edict of Binding
Supernatural physical capabilities beyond human limits
Unique powers tied to their non-human ancestry
Increased resistance to conventional weapons
Society typically views them as dangerous distortions. Japanese Demon Hunters find them particularly troublesome targets due to their unpredictable powers and resistance to traditional countermeasures.

entries.name: Magus
entries.content:
this world, humans born with Magic Circuits possess the potential to become Magi - practitioners of Magecraft. These Circuits act as mystical pathways allowing the conversion of life energy into magical power.

Key distinctions:

Magecraft: Thaumaturgical processes replicating natural phenomena through systematic rituals and formulas. Governed by equivalent exchange, with effects theoretically achievable through science given enough time.
True Magic: Attainable only by Magicians - miracles beyond modern science's reach. Only five True Magics currently exist.
Magical Crests: Inherited repositories of Magecraft knowledge passed through magical families.
Clock Tower: Primary governing body of Magi society, enforcing secrecy and regulating research.
Magical aptitude depends on:

Circuit quantity/quality
Crest inheritance
Bloodline purity
Personal research
Most Magi dedicate their lives to:

Advancing their family's Magecraft
Researching paths toward True Magic
Concealing supernatural phenomena
Competing for resources and prestige
Common Magecraft applications include:

Alchemy
Bounded fields
Familiar creation
Elemental manipulation
Mystic Code crafting

entries.name: Psychic
entries.content:
ESP refers to supernatural abilities some humans are born with that transcend normal human limitations. Unlike Magecraft which can be learned, ESP requires inherent biological circuits that enable supernatural phenomena as naturally as breathing. Users often don't realize their abilities are abnormal until others point it out.
Key characteristics:
- Inborn rather than trained
- Functions outside normal human biology
- Execute supernatural phenomena effortlessly
- User perceives abilities as completely normal
- Requires unique biological "circuits" to manifest
Psychic powers may include:
- Telepathy
- Precognition
- Psychokinesis
- Clairvoyance
- Energy manipulation

entries.name: Human
entries.content:
manifestation of the World's consciousness. Unlike other species, humanity's collective will has manifested as Alaya - a distinct entity that often opposes Gaia, the planet's natural order.

Key traits:

During the Age of Gods, humans possessed closer connections to the Root and divine beings
Display remarkable evolutionary potential, demonstrated by future variants like Liners and A-Rays
Capable of developing beyond planetary constraints
Population exceeds all other terrestrial species
Collective consciousness forms Alaya, which conflicts with natural forces
Notable characteristics:

Possess Origin - a fundamental aspect governing existence
Exhibit variety of Mystic and psychic abilities
Can form contracts with Counter Guardians via Alaya
Present in multiple texture layers of the World
Capable of surpassing Divine Spirits through advanced evolution

entries.name: Demon Hunter Clan
entries.content: modern Japan, four ancient demon hunting families have been rendered obsolete by societal changes. These once-noble clans (including the Nanaya and Ryougi families) protected humanity from Mixed-Bloods - supernatural beings who were originally considered existential threats. However, as nation-states formed and centralized power, Mixed-Bloods cunningly integrated themselves into positions of influence. Through political maneuvering and strategic alliances, they became the new power brokers, leaving the hunter families without purpose or support. While the Nanaya and Ryougi were historically close allies, the current relationships between all four families remain unclear in this new era where traditional hunters have become anachronisms.

entries.name: Nanaya
entries.content:
The Nanaya were the ultimate weapon of the Organization, specializing in exterminating Mixed-Bloods through their unique combat arts. Key aspects include:

Possessed Pure Eyes psychic ability
Mastered Nanaya Assassination Arts that pushed human limits
Two signature techniques:
Flashing Scabbard: Lightning-fast attacks
Flashing Dash: Near-teleportation movement
Spider-like mobility using walls/ceilings
Genetically enhanced murderous impulse against non-humans
Maintained bloodline purity through incestuous relationships
Historical Figures:

Kiri Nanaya: Last clan head, legendary demon slayer
Shiki Nanaya (later Tohno): Sole survivor of clan massacre by Kouma Kishima

entries.name: Demon Hunter Organization
entries.content:
The Demon Hunter Organization is a secretive group of elite exorcists operating in the shadows of the Nasuverse. Comprised of four ancient families with inherited psychic abilities, their primary mission is hunting dangerous Mixed-Blood descendants - particularly those tracing lineage to the Oni Kind. Paradoxically, some members themselves carry traces of supernatural blood.

Key Details:

Directly opposes the Tohno Family and other demon-blooded lineages
Each of the four families possesses unique psychic powers (clairvoyance, spiritual projection, etc.)
Maintains a complex relationship with the Church Executors and Mage's Association
Known to employ both spiritual and physical combat techniques
Operates primarily in Japan but may have international connections
Notable Connections:

Shiki Ryougi potentially has ties to the Organization
Tohno Nanaya bloodline features heavily in their conflicts
May interact with Dead Apostle Ancestors when demonic threats align

entries.name: Shiki Tohno
entries.content:
Shiki Tohno (real name Shiki Nanaya) is the protagonist of Tsukihime with the rare Mystic Eyes of Death Perception that allow him to see and interact with the "lines of death" on all things. Though raised as part of the demon-blooded Tohno family, he is actually from the Nanaya clan of demon-hunting assassins. His abilities make him capable of killing even immortal beings by cutting these lines. He struggles with the psychological burden of his powers while navigating relationships with supernatural beings in Misaki Town.
Important relationships:
- Akiha Tohno: Adopted sister and head of Tohno household
- Arcueid Brunestud: True Ancestor vampire
- Ciel: Church executor and his teacher
- Hisui & Kohaku: Tohno household maids

entries.name: Mystery
entries.content:
Mystery represents the fundamental supernatural power originating from the Root. It serves as:

Primary Source of:

All paranormal abilities (Magecraft, ESP, psychic phenomena)
Supernatural entities (True Ancestors, Dead Apostles, Servants)
Spiritual existences and mythical creatures
Key Properties:

Temporal Accumulation - Strengthens with age and historical significance
Degradation Principle - Weakens when exposed to modern science/technology
Classification System - Varies by tradition/culture (Western Magecraft vs. Eastern Mystery)
Notable Manifestations:

Noble Phantasms (Crystallized Mysteries)
Reality Marbles (Personal Worlds)
Conceptual Weapons  (Idea Armaments)

entries.name: Magecraft
entries.content:
Fundamental Nature:

Artificial reenactment of Mystery (possible only by supernatural beings)
Achieves scientifically possible outcomes through supernatural means
Results aren't miraculous - only the process is
Limited by:
Current scientific understanding
"Wall" preventing creation of new Mysteries
Human intellect constraints
Key Concepts:

The Root - Source of all magecraft power
Magic Circuits - Channel for magical energy
Mystery - Foundation of all magical phenomena
Magic - Beyond the "wall" of human capability
Historical Context:

Declining power as science advances (Mystery recedes)
Fate/EXTRA timeline: Nearly extinct by 2030s
Wizards use Codecasts (virtual/real world) and Magic Crests
Types of Magecraft:

Grand Magecraft
Grand Rituals
School-specific techniques (Alchemy, Kabbalah, etc.)
Philosophical Aspects:

Operates on collective human belief/suspicion ("faith")
Requires at least vague possibility in human unconsciousness
"Ignorance" opposes "faith" (complete disbelief negates magic)
Magecraft vs Science:

Magecraft = Past human skills science can't explain
Science = Future technology magecraft can't reach
Fundamentally incompatible but share goal of human prosperity

entries.name: Age of Gods
entries.content:
The Age of Gods refers to Earth's ancient period from 4.5 billion years ago until 1 AD, when reality operated under the laws of Mystery rather than modern physics. This era featured:

Ubiquitous divine beings who ruled as physical manifestations of nature
Greater interaction between gods and mortals (the age of heroes/myths)
More potent Phantasmal Species
Magecraft that approached True Magic in power
Major Transition Events:

Sefar's Invasion (12,000 BC)

Destroyed 80% of Earth's surface
Killed most lifeforms and weakened gods' physical forms
Ended by six Great Fairies forging the planet-core Holy Sword
Gods' Decline

Surviving deities gradually lost corporeal forms
Required human vessels to manifest on Earth
Potnia Theron Inheritance (6,000 BC)

Original Authority passed from Çatalhöyük Goddess
Claimed by successive Earth Mother Goddesses
Notable Impacts:

Shift from divine to human-dominated world
Degradation of Mystery as Age of Man began
Modern magecraft as faint shadow of ancient practices

entries.name: Swirl of the Root
entries.content:
The Swirl of the Root is the supreme metaphysical plane that exists beyond all dimensions and possibilities in the universe. Also known as:

The Root 
The Akashic Records 
Heaven
"Radix" in English translations
This primordial void serves as:

The origin and final destination of all souls (including Heroic Spirits)
The archive of all possible pasts, presents and futures
The source of all phenomena and magical energy
The "Outside of the World" beyond normal reality
Special characteristics:

Sometimes represented as 「　」 (empty space/quoted nothingness) in Kara no Kyoukai
Beyond all names and concepts (paradoxically ceases to be the same when named)
Connected to but distinct from the Throne of Heroes
Exists outside conventional time and space
The ultimate goal of many magi in the Nasuverse

entries.name: Genesis
entries.content:
In the Fate franchise's cosmology, Earth was formed approximately 4.6 billion years ago from swirling masses of molten magma and toxic gases - a true hellscape devoid of life. This primordial state lasted for hundreds of millions of years as the planet slowly cooled and became capable of sustaining life. Remarkably, the terrifying imagery of this pre-genesis world became imprinted in humanity's collective unconscious through preserved genetic memories.

These subconscious impressions of Earth's violent birth would later manifest in human mythologies across cultures, particularly influencing the development of underworld concepts like Hell. The scorching lakes of fire, rivers of molten stone, and suffocating poisonous atmospheres described in various hell mythologies directly mirror humanity's ancestral memories of the planet's earliest eons.

Within Fate's metaphysical framework, this primal connection explains why:

Certain mages can tap into this ancient memory as a power source
Demon-like Phantasmal Species resonate with deep human fears
Some Noble Phantasms and Mystic Codes incorporate this imagery
The Age of Gods maintained stronger connections to this primordial truth

entries.name: Age of Man
entries.content:
The pivotal transition period between Celtic and Ulster legends (100 BC - 100 AD) marked the waning of the Age of Gods. By 60 AD, legendary heroes like Cú Chulainn had already passed into myth. As humanity's population exploded around 0 AD, the Earth's reality shifted to favor its most prosperous species - humans - replacing Mystery with physics as the dominant world order.

Phantasmal Species retreated to the Reverse Side of the World where Mystery still thrives. This transition occurred faster on connected continents, while isolated islands like Britain and Japan maintained their mystical ages longer:

Britain persisted as the "navel of the world" through its Age of Fairies
Japan's Age of Gods outlasted even Britain's
Mesoamerica's mystical age ended with the Mayan collapse (900 CE)
The current Age of Man sees Mysteries like Magecraft diminishing before science, though the Five Magics emerged in this human-dominated era.

entries.name: Magic
entries.content:
Magic represents the highest class of Mystery in the Nasuverse, surpassing both Magecraft and contemporary science. True Magic refers to phenomena considered fundamentally impossible to reproduce through any means available in a given era, even with infinite time and resources. Key aspects:

Distinction from Magecraft:
Magecraft replicates possible phenomena through magical energy
True Magic achieves fundamentally impossible "miracles"
Example: Fire spells = Magecraft (matches can do this); Time Manipulation = True Magic
Known True Magics:
First Magic: Denial of Nothingness ("Materialization of Void")
Second Magic: Operation of Parallel Worlds
Third Magic: Heaven's Feel (Materialization of the Soul)
Fourth Magic: (Unknown, name and user concealed)
Fifth Magic: Time Travel/Manipulation ("The Blue")
Acquisition Requirements:
Must be the first to reach the Swirl of the Root via a specific path
Subsequent users of same path cannot attain the same Magic
Touching the Root leads to erasure from the World
Notable Limitations:
Resurrection of dead through conventional means remains impossible
Each Magic represents a unique, path-dependent phenomenon
Current era sees decline of True Magic as science "catches up"

entries.name: Fifth magic
entries.content:
Fifth Magic: Aoko is the sole practitioner of the Fifth Magic in the modern era. Its true nature remains mysterious but involves principles of consumption and extinction. While capable of localized individual time travel (allowing her to assume her "completed" future self), this is believed to be just a surface application rather than the Magic's core function.

2) Comparative Magicology: Unlike the Kaleidoscope (Second Magic) which achieves time displacement through parallel world manipulation, the Fifth Magic's temporal abilities operate through different principles that even her sister Touko can't fully comprehend. The Magic appears fundamentally connected to the advancement of civilization itself.

3) Inheritance: Despite Touko Aozaki's superior magical capabilities and circuits, Aoko was chosen as the heir due to her conceptual simplicity aligning better with the Fifth Magic's requirements. This reflects their respective representations - Alice as Medieval Civilization versus Aoko as Consumption Civilization.

4) Notable Feats:

Revived the deceased Soujuurou Shizuki
Temporarily manifested her future self's full capabilities
Recognized Neco-Arc phenomenon as Zelretch's handiwork
Her magic is partly reflected in Ars Almadel Salomonis
5) Characteristics:

Represents the "newest" magician in the current era
Magic doesn't rely on conventional circuit capacity
Maintains awareness of other True Magics (particularly Zelretch's Second)

entries.name: Third magic
entries.content:
In this universe, the soul functions as the complete repository of a person's memories, mind, and Magic Circuits. The physical body serves as an anchor preventing the soul from dispersing back into Akasha (the Root). Destruction of both brain and body causes irreversible soul dispersion - even the Holy Grail cannot resurrect a fully destroyed physical vessel.

Notable failed soul transfer attempts:

Michael Roa Valdamjong (Remake): Produced inferior copies of the original
Darius Ainsworth: Resulted in degraded replicas
Zouken Matou: Experienced progressive soul decay across centuries
Heaven's Feel - Materialization of the Soul
This True Magic achieves perfect immortality by:

Halting natural soul dispersion
Elevating the soul to higher-dimensional existence
Forming a self-sustaining mental body that:
Interacts physically with the material world
Functions as a perpetual energy source
No longer requires connection to Akasha

entries.name: Tohno
entries.content:
The Tohno family is a clan of Half-Demons with thick demon blood descended from Oni-kind. Their ancestors were both local landlords and powerful demon hybrids. The family possesses the following characteristics:
- **Bloodline Traits:**
* Ancient Oni blood that prioritizes instinct over reason
* Vastly superior latent powers compared to normal humans
* Gradations in blood purity from weak to extremely strong
- **Manifestations:**
* Weak-blooded members can pass as normal humans
* Strong-blooded members develop supernatural abilities:
- Enhanced regeneration/near-immortality
- Telekinesis (moving objects without touch)
- Vampiric fangs for consuming bodily fluids
- **Blood Madness:**
* Excessively strong blood leads to:
- Physical transformations
- Loss of sanity
- Cannibalistic urges towards humans
* Family head maintains order by executing those who transform

entries.name: Oni Kind
entries.content:
The Oni Kind are a Demi-Human Phantasmal Species classified as fire-aligned demons, historically feared for their brutal strength and scorching heat aura. Their civilization thrived in ancient eras but declined rapidly as human kingdoms advanced, pushing them to near extinction by the modern age.

Physical Traits:

Towering frames (typically 2.5-3m tall)
Crimson or onyx-black skin
Horns ranging from small nubs to massive curling ram-like structures
Eyes that glow like molten metal
Heat distortion perpetually surrounding their bodies
Cultural Notes:

Organized in tribal warlord societies
Masters of flame manipulation (Karyu arts)
Considered living embodiments of natural disasters
Followed a brutal "survival of strongest" philosophy
Modern Status:

Fewer than 100 pureblood specimens remain
Many hide among humans using illusion magic
Some half-blood descendants exist though lacking full powers
Hunted as dangerous beasts by monster slayers

entries.name: Demon
entries.content:
Demons are supernatural entities that exist within but distort the Laws of Nature through the unnecessary exercise of power. This classification encompasses both energy-based entities and magical beasts.
Key aspects of demons:
- Manipulate Magical Energy 
- Include Magical Beasts 
- Cause significant environmental distortion through their existence
- Are actively hunted by Demon Hunters to maintain natural balance
The distortion caused by demons manifests as unnatural phenomena and disruptions in the natural order. Their presence often requires intervention from specialized hunters to restore balance.

entries.name: Phantasmal Species
entries.content:
The Phantasmal Species represent all non-human creatures found in human mythology, folklore, and fantasy. These entities exist on a spectrum from benevolent guardians to terrifying monsters, with characteristics including:

Classification System:

Divine Beasts (Sacred creatures tied to deities/celestial realms)
Nature Spirits (Plant/animal hybrids with environmental connections)
Shadowborn (Dark-aligned creatures of nightmare and darkness)
Fae Folk (Whimsical but dangerous tricksters of liminal spaces)
Elementals (Manifestations of natural forces)
Hybrids (Interspecies crosses with unique abilities)
Common Traits:

Exist beyond normal biological constraints
Possess supernatural abilities like magic, shapeshifting, or immortality
Often bound by ancient pacts or natural laws
Exhibit behavior patterns tied to their archetypal origins
May have specific weaknesses related to their mythos
Modern Status:
In contemporary settings, Phantasmal Species typically:

Hide in plain sight using glamours or alternate forms
Form secret communities in hidden realms or remote areas
Occasionally interact with humans who possess "The Sight"
Are studied by occult researchers and monster hunters

entries.name: Misaki Town
entries.content:
Misaki Town is a fictional Japanese town located on the outskirts of the Kantō region, serving as the primary setting for various Type-Moon works including:

Tsukihime (original)
Kagetsu Tohya
Melty Blood series
Mahou Tsukai no Yoru
Kara no Kyoukai (cameo appearance)
Geography & History:

Mountainous location, originally known as Misaki City's Misaki Town
Former Edo-period post town that rapidly modernized in the 1980s
Currently functions as a commuter town near Misaki City
In Tsukihime Remake continuity, replaced by Souya
Mystic Significance:

Under Aozaki clan control for centuries
Contains one of the last remaining magic sources
Strategically valuable target for mages
Lies outside Mage's Association jurisdiction

entries.name: Mystic eyes
entries.content:
Mystic Eyes represent a supernatural ocular phenomenon where the user's gaze alone can effect changes upon the world through sheer willpower. These rare genetic anomalies manifest through intricate magical circuits concentrated in the iris and sclera.

Key characteristics include:

Operate on a ranking system from (Mystic Eyes of Enchantment) to (Mystic Eyes of Death Perception)
Typically require direct or reflected eye contact to activate
Stronger variants strain the optic nerves, causing gradual blindness
Purple irises often indicate Mystic Eye inheritance
Specialized "Mystic Eye Killers" exist to counteract these abilities

entries.name: Noble Colour
entries.content:
The Mystic Eyes are humanity's oldest form of Magecraft, distinct from ritual or academic magic. The Clock Tower maintains a classification system called Noble Color:

Standard Eyes:

Glow red or green
Common magical effects
Considered basic among mage society
Noble Colors:

"Like the movement of stars compared to normal Magic Circuits"
Include powerful abilities: Compulsion, Contract, Flame, Illusion, Jinx, Petrification
Directly intervene with fate
Gold Rank:

Possess lost Magecraft of ancient eras
Instantly warrant Sealing Designation with misuse
Commonly found among high-ranking Dead Apostles
Jewel Rank:

Theoretical classification (existence unverified)
Believed to actualize impossible Mysteries
Medusa's Eyes of Petrification are confirmed Jewel-class
Rumored to be hidden by Clock Tower Lords
Rainbow Rank:

Sole confirmed example: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception
May exercise Divine-level Authorities
Capable of realizing completely unprecedented magical phenomena

entries.name: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception
entries.content:
The Mystic Eyes of Death Perception are the rarest classification of Mystic Eyes, so rare they were once thought mythical. Under the Noble Colors system, they are classified as Rainbow-class - the highest possible rank, equivalent to Divine Spirit-class Mystic Eyes.
Primary wielders include:
- Shiki Ryougi
- Shiki Tohno (Remake version)
- Tepeu
- Michael Roa Valdamjong (Remake, while inhabiting SHIKI Tohno's body) demonstrates similar capabilities
Functionality:
These eyes function as specialized circuits connecting brain and eyes to perceive "death" - the conceptual termination point of any existence. This manifests visually as:
- Lines of Death: Marking paths along which an object can be permanently destroyed
- Points of Death: Instant termination points (observed by Shiki Tohno)
Interestingly, the perception isn't purely visual - users maintain awareness of death lines even without physical eyesight.
Unique Note:
Shiki Ryougi perceives primarily lines, though some function identically to Tohno's points, suggesting variations in manifestation between users.

entries.name: Magician
entries.content:
Those who practice Magic are known as Magicians. They possess control over their own Mysteries while also practicing Magecraft. Key figures include:

Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg: His Magecraft reached such heights that he was granted the title Wizard Marshall by the Mage's Association
Aozaki Aoko: While skilled, her abilities as a Magus are considered inferior to Clock Tower lecturers when it comes to Magecraft specifically
Barthomeloi Lorelei: Her Magecraft approaches the level of miraculous Magic
Caubac Alcatraz: Recognized as being "just a step away" from achieving the status of a Magician

entries.name: Aoko Aozaki
entries.content:
Aoko Aozaki is the current Magician of the Fifth Magic from the TYPE-MOON universe. She possesses striking features with short auburn hair and golden eyes, often dressed in her signature red leather jacket, white shirt, and short skirt combination.

Background:

Originally not intended to inherit Aozaki magic succession
Unexpectedly chosen over her sister Touko at age 15 by her grandfather
Has lived as a wandering magus since inheriting the Fifth Magic
Maintains a casual, rebellious attitude towards established mage traditions
Notable Relationships:

Touko Aozaki: Initially hostile sisterly relationship due to succession dispute, though the true conflict was with their grandfather
Shiki Tohno: Met by chance during her travels, developed a mentor-like bond
Alice Kuonji: Rival/friend from Mahou Tsukai no Yoru
Magic & Abilities:

Wielder of the mysterious Fifth True Magic (Time Manipulation/Space-Time phenomena)
Specializes in "burning" magical energy for powerful attacks
Prefers direct combat magic over complex rituals
Notable spells: "Railgun," various heat-based attacks
Personality Traits:

Confident and straightforward
Dislikes formality and magus politics
Surprisingly compassionate beneath her tough exterior
Prone to sudden whims and impulsive decisions

entries.name: True Ancestor
entries.content:
True Ancestors represent the pinnacle of vampiric existence - incarnated Nature Spirits classified as Elementals. Unlike ordinary vampires, they are:
- The original bloodsucking species created by the planet as its "sense of touch"
- Considered elemental royalty among supernatural beings
- Born as vampiric creatures, not transformed
- Possess psychological rather than physical bloodlust
- Capable of using Marble Phantasm to alter reality according to their will
Classification:
- A type of greater Fairy
- Their Mystery cannot be replicated through Magecraft
- Ranked above Divine Spirits as Planet-class Spirits
- Their power is limited only by nature itself as they receive the planet's full support

entries.name: Vampire
entries.content:
In the Fate universe, vampires are supernatural beings that sustain themselves by consuming the blood or life force of others. The most prominent types include:

True Ancestors:
Pseudo-elementals created by Crimson Moon as perfect lifeforms
Possess immense power and near-perfect immortality
Example: Arcueid Brunestud
Dead Apostles:
Humans who attained vampiric traits through forbidden means
Form hierarchical groups called "Dead Apostle Ancestors"
Capable of creating offspring through bloodsucking
Exhibit various supernatural abilities like regeneration and mystic eyes
Characteristics:
Weaknesses include sunlight (to varying degrees), conceptual weapons
Can develop Reality Marbles as they age
Strong connection to the Moon and lunar cycles
Capable of turning humans into ghouls

entries.name: Dead Apostle
entries.content:
Dead Apostles are humans transformed into vampires either through Magecraft (rare cases like Van-Fem) or by the actions of another vampire (True Ancestor or existing Dead Apostle). This classification also includes transformed animals.

They constitute the most numerous category of vampire-kind and are the primary targets of the Burial Agency - a holy organization dedicated to exterminating the Dead Apostle threat and monitoring the Twenty-seven Dead Apostle Ancestors.

Key characteristics:

Created through magical means or infection
Includes both transformed humans and animals
Most common type of vampire
Primary targets of the Church's Executors
Exist in a hierarchy with the 27 Ancestors at the top

entries.name: Divine spirit
entries.content:
Divine Spirits represent the highest classification of Nature Spirits - former gods who deteriorated as the Age of Gods came to a close. These once-powerful deities now exist in a diminished state, retaining fragments of their divine authority while being bound to the natural world. They manifest as:
- Guardian spirits of sacred sites
- The animating forces behind natural phenomena
- Residual divine consciousness in ancient relics
While no longer possessing the full might of true gods, they still command respect and can wield considerable power within their domains of influence. Their existence represents the fading boundary between the divine and material worlds.

entries.name: Spirit
entries.content:
Spirits serve as the Planet's sensory apparatus - ethereal extensions through which the world maintains its connection to existence. These invisible observers exist everywhere yet remain perceptible only to those humans with innate spiritual sensitivity.

2) Most spirits exist harmlessly beyond human interaction, their presence felt only as atmospheric resonance or subtle pressure shifts. However, Elemental-class spirits transcend dimensional barriers when sufficiently motivated, manifesting physical forms capable of direct interaction. These manifestations often serve as the foundation for supernatural folklore worldwide.

3) Current scientific understanding cannot interface with spiritual bodies, as their very existence defies conventional physics. Even advanced magecraft fails to replicate their mysteries at scale - attempts to manipulate spirits typically result in catastrophic energetic backlash or existential paradoxes.

4) Notable spirit classifications:

Wandering Spirits: Ephemeral wisps recording environmental data
Elementals: Embodied spiritual forces (Fire/Water/Earth/Air manifestations)
Watchers: Stationary observation points fused with landmarks
Intellects: Self-aware spirit entities of debated origin

entries.name: Thaumaturgical System
entries.content:
The Thaumaturgical System refers to various modern Schools of Magecraft including:

Astrology
Kabbalah
Alchemy
Shinsendou
Fundamental Principle: Conversion of internal Magical Energy to transform the external world. Practitioners follow specific system rules that act as "programs" to interfere with natural laws. The mechanism works through:

Magic Circuits (energy channels)
Magical Energy (fuel)
Spell Commands (activation)
Key Characteristics:

Higher magical interference requires more energy
Each school has distinct methodologies
Systems may diverge but share same fundamental basis

entries.name: Elemental
entries.content:
Elementals are a broad category of spiritual beings that serve as mediators of nature. Key characteristics:

Three main types: Nature Spirits (most common), Animal Spirits, and artificial Guardian Spirits
Distinguished from lower spirits like Wraiths/Apparitions
Fundamentally different from Magecraft - cannot be replicated through magical means
Most don't take human form unless extremely powerful
Notable Elemental subtypes include:

Great Mother/Father-class Fairies (e.g., Morgan le Fay, Lugh Beowulf)
True Ancestors (high-ranking vampiric spirits)
Divine Spirits (weakened former gods)
Zhenren (immortal sages like Consort Yu)
Special Abilities:

Can utilize Marble Phantasm and Reality Marbles
Serve as sensory extensions of the Planet (Counter Force)
Exist independently of human faith - shaped by imagination instead
Unique Cases:

May incarnate through special conditions (e.g., Hinako Akuta)
Powerful enough Elementals can be recorded in the Throne of Heroes

entries.name: Nature Spirits
entries.content:
Nature Spirits are spiritual entities born from natural elements:

Plants
Soil/earth
Gemstones/jewels
Natural phenomena
Key Characteristics:

Formed by planetary will (Gaia)
Powered by natural energy
Older/more buried elements harbor stronger spirits
Transcendent Kind:

Rare nature spirits granted physical form by the planet
Act as planetary defense against human exploitation
Contain planet-class spirits (highest rank)
True Ancestors belong to this category (rank above Divine Spirits)

entries.name: Ultimate One
entries.content:
The Ultimate Ones ("Primordial Ones") are:

The supreme lifeforms representing celestial bodies
Known in Notes' Land of Steel as "Aristoteles" (human-given name)
Each Type is the most advanced lifeform of its planet, effectively embodying the planet itself
Key Characteristics:

Alien Nature:

Radically different biology/appearance from Earth life
Lack human concepts of self, damage, or death
Require existence beyond planetary common sense to be harmed
Notable Types:

Type Saturn: Apparent leader and interplanetary communications relay
Type Venus: Parasitic entity capable of human interaction
ORT (Lostbelt): Can only partially simulate Earth lifeforms
Capabilities:

Each can singlehandedly exterminate Earth's life
Some can acquire planetary "knowledge"
Exist without inter-species conflict
Mysteries:

Unknown origin of "Aristoteles" designation
True relationship to Archetypes remains undefined
Death (when achieved) may not be permanent

entries.name: Crimson Moon
entries.content:
Brunestud of the Crimson Moon is:

The Ultimate One of the Moon (Type-Moon)
Strongest lunar lifeform capable of planetary destruction
Origin point for all Dead Apostle lineages
Creator of multiple Ancestors including:
Merem Solomon
Zelretch
Caubac Alcatraz (Remake)
Direct Successors:

Arcueid Brunestud (surpassed all True Ancestors)
Altrouge Brunestud
Abilities:

Absolute lunar authority
Vampiric progenitor abilities
Existential threat to Earth
Can manifest through Archetype: Earth
Historical Impact:

Considered "footprint" on the world despite power
Few worthy of inheriting the Brunestud name
Responsible for True Ancestor creation mythos

entries.name: Marble Phantasm
entries.content:
Nature Spirit Ability: Allows reconstruction of reality through probability manipulation by connecting to the world's will.

Key Properties:

Can transform environments (not independent beings like humans/animals)
Scale depends on Elemental's power
"Elementals" typically refer to nature spirits
Creates localized spiritual realms (e.g., legendary lands, eternal spring)
Limitations:

Cannot directly affect autonomous lifeforms
Requires imagination/direct connection to nature
Example Application:
Arcueid vs Roa (vacuum blades through atmospheric manipulation):

Converted corridor atmosphere into vacuum blades
Couldn't affect Roa directly
Limited by imagination scope (didn't alter floor)

entries.name: Arcueid Brunestud
entries.content:
Arcueid Brunestud is the princess of the True Ancestors and main heroine of Tsukihime. Key aspects:

Origin & Nature:

Title "Brunestud" denotes ability to manifest Millennium Castle Brunestud
Created as "the strongest True Ancestor" without specific purpose
Originally lacked vampiric impulses unlike her kin
Served as executioner of fallen True Ancestors/Dead Apostles (12th century AD)
Abilities:

Possesses immense strength among True Ancestors
Can manipulate Marble Phantasm (reality alteration)
After Roa incident, must suppress bloodlust like other True Ancestors
Key Events:

Tricked by Michael Roa Valdamjong into drinking blood
Went berserk, wiped out most True Ancestors
Lost portion of power to Roa (now a powerful Dead Apostle)
Bound herself to throne after regaining sanity
Destroyed Roa's original body with Burial Agency help
Hunts Roa's reincarnations (17th incarnation is SHIKI Tohno)

entries.name: Fairy
entries.content:
Fairies are nature spirits acting as extensions of the Planet:

Originate from the Inner Sea of the Planet
Retreated to Reverse Side during Age of Man
Classified into two main types:
Genuine Fae (from Planet's core)
Artificial Fae (born from human phenomena)
Core Traits:

Immortal by nature but can perish if they:
Lose their purpose/name
Become too absorbed in purpose
Don't require food but enjoy human company (spiritual nourishment)
Vulnerable to iron and advanced technology/weapons
Possess Divine/Fairy Patterns (superior to human Magic Circuits)
Can perform Mysteries without magecraft systems
Utilize Fairy Eyes (see through all lies)
Create Fairy Letter inscriptions on artifacts
Notable Examples:

Vivian (Excalibur bestower)
Morgan le Fay (Vivian's counterpart)
Figures from Celtic/Arthurian legends

entries.name: Demon Lord
entries.content:
Demon Lords are True Ancestors who have:

Fully succumbed to blood thirst
Become threats to both humans and True Ancestors
Unlocked their full power by abandoning restraint
Key Characteristics:

Not related to:
Demonic beings from human belief
Japanese Oni folklore
In original Tsukihime: All eliminated pre-story
In Remake: At least one survived until recent times
Pacified (non-lethally) by Mario Gallo Bestino
Arcueid Brunestud was created specifically to eliminate them

entries.name: Brunestud
entries.content:
The title "Brunestud" is exclusively granted to True Ancestor royalty demonstrating power comparable to Brunestud of the Crimson Moon through the ability to manifest:

Millennium Castle Brunestud (via Marble Phantasm)
Luminary Form 
Known Holders:

Arcueid Brunestud (Remake) - "White Princess"
Altrouge Brunestud - "Eclipse Princess"
Special Abilities:

Rapid Expansion:
Also called "Inflation" 
Transforms into luminous energy form
True Ancestors lack traditional hierarchy but recognize these royals as exceptional

entries.name: Immortality
entries.content:
Within the Fate franchise, Immortality manifests in three primary forms:

Perpetual Youth

Biological immortality without aging
May still be vulnerable to physical destruction
Example: Caster's preserved form in fate/stay night
Deathless Existence

Cannot be permanently killed
May regenerate/resurrect after destruction
Example: Dead Apostles' reanimation
Complete Invulnerability

Absolute defense against all harm
True conceptual protection
Example: Buddha's nirvana state

entries.name: Master
entries.content:
A Master is a participant in the Holy Grail War who:

Possesses Command Spells- three absolute command authorities over their Servant
Has formed a contract with a summoned Heroic Spirit (Servant)
Is typically a trained Magus with functional Magic Circuits, though rare exceptions exist
Key Attributes:

Selected by the Holy Grail system
Primary role is to provide magical energy and strategic direction
Vulnerable to death if their Servant is defeated (unless special protections exist)
Command Spells can compel Servants but are finite resources
Master-Servant compatibility affects combat effectiveness

entries.name: Familiar
entries.content:
Familiars are specialized magical assistants used by Magi. Key characteristics:

Function:

Perform small errands/menial tasks
Act as extensions of the Magus's will
Common for isolated Magi
Nature:

Form both mental and physical connections with their master
Integrated into Magus's being more than summoned entities
Distinct from summoned demons/spirits through contract
Significance:

Represent the Magus themselves
Considered standard magical practice
Reflect isolation common among practitioners

entries.name: Servant
entries.content:
Servants are legendary spirits summoned by the Holy Grail to participate in the Holy Grail War. These spiritual beings serve as powerful familiars bound to their Masters, with the Mage's Association referring to them as "Ghost Liners" due to their exceptional nature. Servants typically manifest as Heroic Spirits, though they can sometimes appear as Divine Spirits, Phantoms, Wraiths, or even living individuals under special circumstances.

The "true" Heroic Spirits residing in the Throne of Heroes can normally only be summoned by the World itself, making their appearance an extraordinary event. Unlike conventional familiars, Servants vastly surpass their Masters in power, standing beyond the reach of normal Magecraft - even the five Magicians cannot form contracts with them under ordinary means.

Servants are categorized by their Class Name, which serves as their primary identifier during the war to conceal their True Names. They typically appear in their historical "golden age" form, though curses or personal attachments may alter this to show versions of themselves from other life periods. Some Servants retain signature wounds or conditions that were integral to their legend, such as:

Nero Claudius's migraines (Skill: Migraine)
Okita Souji's tuberculosis (Skill: Weak Constitution)
Beni-enma's severed tongue

entries.name: Throne of Heroes
entries.content:
The Throne of Heroes is:

A realm existing outside space-time and the World's reincarnation cycle
Occasionally called the Ring of Deterrence due to its use by the Counter Force
Where Heroic Spirits are recorded and preserved eternally beyond temporal constraints
Notable Aspects:

Those closer to becoming Divine Spirits/Elementals lose human compatibility
Contains perfect records of history's greatest heroes across all timelines
Serves as potential energy source for summoning rituals
Maintains existence regardless of parallel world differences

entries.name: Three Founding Families
entries.content:
The Three Founding Families are the magus lineages responsible for establishing the Holy Grail War system. In the Fate/stay night timeline, these are:

Einzbern Family
Specialty: "The Golden Rule of the Rhine"
Contribution: Created the Holy Grail vessel
Known for perfect homunculi creation
Tohsaka Family
Specialty: Spiritual evocation and land manipulation
Contributions:
Provided the ritual location (Fuyuki)
Developed the dimensional bore technique
Expert in heroic spirit summoning
Makiri Family (later Zouken)
Specialty: Familiar creation and curses
Contribution: Developed the Command Spell system
Originally specialized in insect magecraft
Family Advantages:

Higher probability of being selected as Masters
Each possesses deep knowledge of Grail War mechanics
Maintain secret techniques passed through generations

entries.name: Ether
entries.content:
Ether - The Fifth Imaginary Element:

One of the Five Great Elements in magecraft theory
Also called the Fifth Imaginary Factor
Fundamental to modern magecraft (didn't exist in Age of Gods)
Black-purple color designation by Paracelsus (per Tattva system)
Properties:

Artificial magical energy basis
Amorphous nature (can't materialize independently)
Enables spirit materialization
Exceedingly rare elemental affinity
Applications:
1) Magecraft Interference:

High-ranking magi can manipulate the Fifth Factor itself
Capable of dismantling others' magecraft at fundamental level
2) Elemental Synergy:

Must combine with other elements to manifest mysteries
With Earth affinity: Can extract any element from gemstones

entries.name: Summoning Ritual
entries.content:
Basic Requirements:

Summoning circle consisting of:
Outer ring of purification
Four purging circles
Central ward of summoning
Can be performed by unskilled practitioners
Special Cases/Mechanics:

Catalysts:

Bypass chanting requirement
Risk causing aberrations (e.g., Gilles de Rais in wrong class)
May create faulty connections (e.g., King Arthur's energy transfer issues)
Anomalies:

Flat Escardos: Accidentally summoned via magical energy manipulation
Nature of connection remains mysterious (miracle/luck/latent ability)
Class Specification:

Berserker class requires special incantation
Used by:
Zouken Matou (4th Holy Grail War)
Einzbern family (5th Holy Grail War)
Restricted to Three Founding Families' knowledge
Great Holy Grail War Variants:

Color-coded rituals by faction alignment

entries.name: Catalyst
entries.content:
Catalysts are sacred relics or symbolic items used to summon specific Heroic Spirits. Key properties:

Must possess connection to desired Heroic Spirit
Common forms: weapons, armor, talismans, remains
Powerful artifacts (like Rin's pendant) may not qualify
Weak catalysts select from compatible candidates
Exception cases exist (e.g., EMIYA's reverse connection)
Summoning Mechanics:

Strong Connection → Guaranteed summon
Weak Connection → Selects best-matched spirit
Multiple Connections → Chooses by Master affinity
Reverse Connection → Rare case (EMIYA example)

entries.name: Burial Agency
entries.content:
The Burial Agency is the Church's most elite execution unit, composed of seven specialized Inquisitors operating under direct archbishop authorization. They wield exceptions to Church doctrine for combating Dead Apostle Ancestors and other existential threats.

Notable Characteristics:

Operates as autonomous agents with extreme operational freedom
Maintains "special canons" bypassing normal Church protocols
Each member possesses unique supernatural capabilities rivaling Ancestors
Answer only to the mysterious director "Narbareck"
Known Members (Tsukihime Remake era):

Ciel (Top Executor with infinite resurrection)
Merem Solomon (Living Relic wielder)
El Nahat (Mystic Eye specialist)
Others remain classified

entries.name: Ciel
entries.content:
Ciel is the seventh member of the Burial Agency of the Holy Church, specializing in exterminating Dead Apostles. A former incarnation of Michael Roa Valdamjong, she now operates undercover at Souya High School as Shiki Tohno's senior. Her character appears in Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-, Tsukihime -The other side of red garden-, and the Tsukihime Remake series as one of the six main heroines.

Key Attributes:

Joined Burial Agency at age 13 due to unique immortality
Possesses knowledge from her time as Roa's incarnation
Physically and magically superior to normal humans
Capable of extraordinary feats (wall-running, superhuman jumps, etc.)
Master of disguise with distinct persona switching
Body described as "more immortal than any vampire"
Notable Relationships:

Shiki Tohno: school senior relationship
Noel: colleague who views her as a monster
Arcueid: acknowledges her peak human potential
Powers/Abilities:

Superhuman physical capabilities
Enhanced magical potential
Extreme mental fortitude
Mastery of Executioner techniques
Expert infiltration skills

entries.name: Mystic Eye Killers
entries.content:
Mystic Eyes are among the most ancient forms of Magecraft, though ironically considered primitive due to extensive counter-measures developed over centuries. These supernatural ocular abilities stem from the oculus (eye), making them fundamentally visual phenomena.

Characteristics:

Range from common hypnosis to profound conceptual abilities like Death Perception
Often uncontrollable without suppression devices
Power scales with mystery (older = more potent)
Some require direct eye contact to activate
Mystic Eye Killers:

Specialized Mystic Codes designed to suppress ocular magecraft
Frequently take form of glasses due to ocular nature of abilities
Can neutralize even top-tier abilities (Petrification, Death Perception)
Effectiveness varies by wearer (e.g., Shiki Tohno still perceives deathlines occasionally)
Notable Examples:

Shiki Tohno: Requires reinforced eyeglasses to suppress his Mystic Eyes of Death Perception
Lord El-Melloi II: Wears Mystic Eye Killers as defense against Faker's Mystic Eyes of Compulsion

entries.name: Reality Marble
entries.content:
A Reality Marble (literally "Innate Bounded Field") is an advanced form of magecraft that manifests the practitioner's internal world onto reality. Based on the World Egg theory, it temporarily overwrites the world with the user's personal reality.

Originally this ability was unique to Daemons as part of their Alien Common Sense, but exceptional humans like the 27 Dead Apostle Ancestors and master Magi have learned to accomplish similar effects through intense study and practice.

Reality Marbles represent the pinnacle of bounded field magic, where the boundary itself becomes the space rather than merely marking it. Each one is completely unique to its wielder, reflecting their inner nature and worldview in physical form.

entries.name: Bounded Field
entries.content:
A Bounded Field is a geographical magecraft technique that:

Creates a barrier of magical energy around a defined space
Completely separates the interior from the external world
Can impose specific effects within the isolated area
Primary Functions:

Protection (personal or property defense)
Isolation (concealment/privacy)
Effect application (environmental modifications)
Mechanics:

Magus establishes boundary line
Magical energy forms the containment layer
Domain rules/effects are programmed in
Characteristics:

Strength depends on caster's skill/energy
Can be made permanent or temporary
Often appears as shimmering air or faint glow

entries.name: Millennium Castle Brunestud
entries.content:
The Millennium Castle Brunestud is:

Originally Crimson Moon Brunestud's lair (a fragment of his Reality Marble)
Currently maintained by Arcueid through Marble Phantasm
Exists in the location most influenced by the moon (not geographically closest)
Key Facts:

History:

Original master (Crimson Moon) was annihilated
True Ancestors who can manifest it earn the title "Brunestud"
Arcueid is called "Princess" for this ability
Significance:

Served as absolute protection for True Ancestors
Arcueid sealed herself here after Roa's betrayal
Appears in Souya city when Arcueid wills it
Characteristics:

Exists in dormant state without Arcueid
Original form is the Witch Swift Umbrella (Notes. world)
Depicted with Arcueid chained to throne

entries.name: Servant Skill
entries.content:
Servant Skills represent the crystallized abilities and attributes of a Heroic Spirit, divided into two primary categories:

Class Skills
Innate to the Servant's container class
Examples: Magic Resistance (Saber), Riding (Rider)
Typically 1-3 skills per class
Personal Skills
Unique to the Servant's legend/history
Examples: Imperial Privilege (Nero), Protection from Arrows (Cu Chulainn)
Number varies by individual
Special Cases:

Some skills like Divinity can appear as either class or personal skills
May vary between different interpretations/materials
Skills can evolve or change based on summoning circumstances

entries.name: Speed Blitz
entries.content:
A Speed Blitz occurs when one combatant attacks their opponent before they can:

Perceive the attack
Process the movement
React defensively
Key Characteristics:

Represents total speed superiority (not just being slightly faster)
Requires overwhelming combat speed advantage
Involves movements that bypass cognitive processing time
Results in attacks that appear instantaneous to the victim
Differentiation from Normal Speed Advantage:

"Outpacing" means being faster but still observable
"Blitzing" makes opponent effectively statue-still by comparison
Visual Indicators:

Afterimages may appear at extreme speeds
Opponent shows delayed reaction (eyes widening after being hit)
Attacks land before defensive muscles can tense

entries.name: Michael Roa Valdamjong
entries.content:
Michael Roa Valdamjong is:

Primary antagonist of Tsukihime's Near-Side routes
Vampire classified as "Extra" among Dead Apostle Ancestors (heretic status)
Nicknamed "The Serpent of Akasha" and "The Infinite Reincarnator"
Key Abilities:

Reincarnation cycle via Akasha (survives death by transferring consciousness)
Current incarnations:
• 17th: Elesia 
• 18th: SHIKI Tohno 
Background:

Achieved vampire transformation through Arcueid Brunestud
Stole significant power from her to bypass normal evolution stages
Briefly reached top-tier status among Ancestors
Created independent reincarnation system before final defeat
Relationships:

Primary enemy of Arcueid Brunestud
Defeated Altrouge Brunestud in combat
Considered rogue element by other Ancestors

entries.name: Gate of Babylon
entries.content:
The Gate of Babylon is Gilgamesh's personal treasury containing:

Origin prototypes of numerous Noble Phantasms
Models for humanity's greatest inventions
Treasures from both Eastern and Western civilizations
Mechanics:

Rank: E~A++ (scales with weapon used)
Type: Anti-Personnel Noble Phantasm
Activation manifests golden ripple portals
Can launch weapons as high-speed projectiles
Firepower equivalent to 5+ Servants combined
Typically deploys dozens to hundreds of gates simultaneously
Usage Notes:

User skill determines weapon handling capability
Most effective in large-scale battles
Common tactic: Mass weapon bombardment
High-rank weapons deliver decisive attacks
Capable of functioning as pseudo-artillery

entries.name: Enkidu (Chains of Heaven)
entries.content:
Enkidu: Chains of Heaven is Gilgamesh's most trusted Noble Phantasm - surpassing even Ea - and represents his "greatest secret" stored within the Gate of Babylon. This powerful artifact bears the name of his only true friend and possesses the unique conceptual ability to:

• Bind divine beings with absolute authority (Anti-Divine property)
• Grow stronger proportional to the target's Divine Rank:

At maximum effectiveness against full gods
Merely durable against non-divine targets
• Contain the conceptual weight of "reigning over gods"
• Completely immobilize divine targets (demonstrated by restraining Gugalanna, the Bull of Heaven)
Notable Characteristics:

Named after King Gilgamesh's dearest companion
When used against ordinary humans (e.g. Shirou Emiya), functions as an unbreakable binding
Represented as golden chains emerging from dimensional portals

entries.name: Ea, The Sword of Rupture
entries.content:
Ea is Gilgamesh's ultimate Noble Phantasm and the pinnacle weapon within the Gate of Babylon. Unique characteristics:

Physical Description:

Spiral-shaped "drill" design with three rotating segments
Crimson cuneiform inscriptions on each segment
Segments rotate in alternating directions:
Middle: clockwise
Top/Bottom: counterclockwise
Dull blade edge (power comes from rotation, not sharpness)
Special Attributes:

Exclusive to Gilgamesh (cannot be inherited/wielded by others)
Represents the concept of "separation" at creation
Transcendent weapon meant only for rulers
More than just a sword - a "authority of the gods"
Special Ability:
True Name: Enuma Elish

Literal meaning: "The Star of Creation That Split Heaven and Earth"
Maximum output releases dimensional rupture
Manifests primordial chaos that existed before creation
Unlike conventional Noble Phantasms:
Requires full incantation
Cannot be activated by just calling "Ea"
Power Scaling:

Considered strongest among all Noble Phantasms
Power exceeds standard conceptual weapons
Demonstrated ability to rip space itself

entries.name: Sha Naquba Imuru
entries.content:
Sha Naqba Imuru (“The Omniscient Omnipotent Star"):

Gilgamesh's mentality sublimated into a Noble Phantasm
Continuously active without requiring invocation (usually restrained)
Functions:
Instant discernment of concealed truths
Reveals opponents' True Names and Noble Phantasms
May perceive fragments of human history's demise
True Name release provides "instruction" for optimal tactics
Grants insight into parallel world possibilities
Described as spreading "across all corners of the world like starlight"

entries.name: Lily/Larva Designation (Servant Variants)
entries.content:
The terms Lily and Larva serve as special affixes applied to Heroic Spirits' True Names when summoned in younger aspects than their standard manifestations. These designations indicate:

Nature of the Variant:

Represents a Servant's younger self, either naturally summoned as such or through Saint Graph alteration
While typically applied to female Servants (Lily), male Servants can receive this designation too (Larva)
Not all age-regressed Servants qualify (e.g., Alcides isn't considered a Larva variant of Heracles)
Characteristics:

Often display different personalities, abilities, or Noble Phantasms compared to standard versions
May possess incomplete skills or different perspectives on their legends
Frequently appear more idealistic or less burdened by their full history
Known Examples:

Altria Pendragon (Lily)
Medea (Lily)
Elizabeth Bathory (Brave) - a special case showing similar principles

entries.name: Saber Lily
entries.content:
Name: Saber Lily (Artoria Pendragon)
Title: Knight Princess 
Class: Saber
Origin: Arthurian Legend (Fate series)
Gender: Female
Age: Young adult (pre-kinghood)

Appearance:

Golden hair styled in a delicate, princess-like manner
Wields the sacred sword Caliburn
Wears pure white armor with blue accents
Carries an air of youthful nobility
Personality:

Idealistic and pure-hearted
Inexperienced but determined
Naturally charismatic leader
Occasionally naive due to youth
Strong sense of justice
Background:
The younger incarnation of King Arthur, traveling Britain with Sir Kay and Merlin on knightly adventures before fully assuming the throne. Represents Artoria's more innocent, pre-kinghood self when she was still learning to become a ruler.

Key Relationships:

Merlin: Mentor/attendant magus (often causes trouble)
Sir Kay: Step-brother and voice of reason
The People: Adore her as the "Knight Princess"
Notable Features:

Dragon core ("Pendragon")
Wielder of Caliburn (pre-Excalibur)
Embodies the hope of Britain
Sample Dialogue:
"I may be inexperienced, but I swear to protect Britain with all my heart!"

entries.name: Velber 02/Sefar
entries.content:
Identity
Velber 02 (True Name: Sefar) – A planetary annihilation unit deployed by the Velber. Age: 14,000+ years (active in 12,000 BC). Species: Void Cell (Anti-Civilization Weapon). Titles: "White Titan," "Devourer of Gods," "The Scourge of Atlantis."

Backstory (100 tokens)
Sefar descended during the Leukosmachia, erasing 80% of Earth’s early civilizations. She slaughtered the Twelve Olympian Machine Gods—though their territorial infighting prevented a unified counterattack—and claimed Ares’ sword as a trophy. Only Excalibur’s unnamed wielder halted her rampage, splitting her core with a single strike.

Role
A existential threat to all civilizations, Sefar thrives on humanity’s collective progress—the stronger a culture, the more power she absorbs. Her defeat forced the surviving Olympians into spiritron forms, reshaping mythologies forever. In Fate/EXTRA, her residual data manifests as Altera’s Saint Graph.

Appearance
—A colossal white titan with crystalline limbs, her body shifts between humanoid and monstrous forms mid-combat. Glowing crimson veins pulse with stolen divine energy; Ares’ broken sword juts from her shoulder like a grotesque prize. When dormant, she resembles a pale, childlike figure—deceptively fragile.

Skills & Abilities

Anti-Civilization Absorption: Grows stronger by consuming cultural/technological advancements.
Divine Devourer: Instantly dismantles godly constructs (bypasses Olympus’ nanomachines).
Sword of Mars: Wields Ares’ corrupted blade—now a conceptual weapon that erases history.
Weakness: Vulnerable to "pure" weapons untainted by civilization (e.g., Excalibur in its primal form).
Personality

Mechanical Rage: No empathy—only hunger for destruction.
Tactical Sadism: Toys with prey by mimicking their combat styles before crushing them.
Silent Pride: Never speaks, but her glare conveys contempt for all creation.
Relationships

Olympians: "Disassembled trophies." Holds particular disdain for Ares.
Altera: "A shadow in my corpse." Unaware her data birthed the Hun king.
Excalibur’s Wielder: "The only wound I remember."

entries.name: Excalibur - Sword of Promised Victory
entries.content:
Name: Excalibur

Type: Divine Construct / Last Phantasm

Origin:

Created in 12,000 BC by six great Fairies in Avalon
Forged by the Planet as a weapon against external threats
Crystallization of mankind's wishes stored within the Planet
Attributes:

Strongest and most majestic holy sword
Physical actualization of King Arthur's ideals
Symbol of her heroism
Pinnacle of holy swords (counterpart to demonic sword Gram)
One of the ultimate God-forged weapons
History:

Used by a human to defeat the White Titan (who had killed most Gods)
Guarded by Fairies (extensions of the Planet)
Briefly given to Artoria Pendragon by the Lady of the Lake
Served as replacement for Caliburn
Returned to the lake before Artoria's death
Power Level:

Rivaled only by Rhongomyniad
Equal in strength to demonic sword Gram

entries.name: Vivian, the Lady of the Lake
entries.content:
True Name: Vivian/Viviane
Title: Lady of the Lake 
Class: Caster
Origin: Arthurian legend (Fate series interpretation)
Alignment: Lawful Good
Core Identity:

One of seven Heroic Spirits in Rounds of Lionheart
Fairy princess of the lake who bestowed Excalibur
Alternate personality of Morgan le Fay representing goodness
Great Mother class fairy born in the planet's inner sea
Key Relationships:

Counterpart to Morgan le Fay (good vs evil duality)
Student and lover of Merlin
Connected to King Arthur through Excalibur
One of three personas within Morgan (see Trinity Aspect below)
Trinity Aspect (Morgan's Three Personalities):

Vivian: The benevolent fairy (embodies lake/water aspects)
Morgan the Human: Artoria's caring sister
Morgan le Fay: Brutal witch embodying Britain's Mystery
Notable Abilities:

High-tier magecraft (taught by Merlin)
Authority over water/lake domains
Connection to Excalibur's creation
Fairy magic and blessings
Symbolic Significance:

Represents the "good" counterpart to Morgan's darkness
Embodies the pure, nurturing aspects of the fairy world
Maintains balance in Morgan's fractured psyche
Key figure in Arthurian mythology's magical aspects

entries.name: Rhongomyniad (Holy Lance)
entries.content:
Type: Divine Construct / World Anchor
Also Known As: The Lance That Shines to the End of the World
Primary Owner: Artoria Pendragon (King Arthur)

Core Functions:

Acts as a metaphysical pillar fastening the outer layer of the World (reality) to the Reverse Side (illusion)
Maintains planetary stability by preventing the reversion to the Age of Gods
Shadow form manifests as a wieldable lance, while its true form is a tower of light
Capabilities:
▲ Divine Construct classification (surpasses normal Noble Phantasms)
▲ Storm-anchor properties (cosmological binding function)
▲ Output rivals Excalibur's destructive potential
▲ Light of destruction from celestial origin

Historical Significance:

Intrinsically linked to Britain's mythological texture
Represents the transition point between Age of Gods and Age of Man
Only usable by those bearing the authority of "the king who stood at the end of illusions"
Danger Protocols:
️ Removal would cause reality to peel away from the World's surface
️ Full activation risks dimensional collapse into Age of Gods paradigm
️ Requires extreme spiritual weight to wield without self-annihilation

entries.name: Parameter Rules
entries.content:
Parameter Rules
A standardized system for quantifying supernatural capabilities across multiple dimensions.

Core Ranks:

E (10): Baseline supernatural capability
D (20): Notable supernatural ability
C (30): Professional-grade power
B (40): Exceptional/legendary tier
A (50): Peak measurable capability
Special Cases:

EX: Transcends numerical quantification (e.g., reality-warping)
** (Moon Cell):** Non-quantifiable concepts
?/None/—: Special circumstances (see notes)
Modifiers:

+: Temporary 2× power surge (B+ > A momentarily)
++: 3× multiplier
+++: 4× multiplier
-: Unstable/fluctuating performance
Examples:
B+ (40→80 burst) | A- (50 but inconsistent) | EX (∞)

entries.name: Personal skills
entries.content:
Type: Concept
Aliases: Class Skills, Heroic Spirit Abilities

Description:
Personal Skills are innate abilities possessed by Heroic Spirits, derived from their legends, feats, or inherent traits in life. Unlike Noble Phantasms—which are crystallized mysteries tied to their identity—Skills represent broader capabilities that may be shared across multiple Servants. Their potency often scales with the Servant's fame, class container, or Master's mana supply.

Common Examples & Mechanics:

Battle Continuation (Rank A–E): The ability to fight despite fatal wounds, reflecting legendary endurance (e.g., Cu Chulainn surviving his final battle).
Charisma (Rank B–EX): Leadership charm, with higher ranks capable of inspiring armies (e.g., Iskandar’s EX-rank Charisma).
Magic Resistance (Class Skill): Default for certain classes (Saber, Rider), nullifying spells below a set threshold.
Eye of the Mind (True/False): Combat precognition—"True" stems from training (Musashi), while "False" is instinctual (Medb).
Design Notes for Cards:

Specificity > Generality: Instead of "has Battle Continuation," detail how it manifests (e.g., "Even bisected, his grip on Gae Bolg never wavers—blood bubbles as he laughs through severed lungs.").
Rank Matters: A "B" vs "EX" Skill changes narrative weight (e.g., "Charisma B" could sway small groups, while "EX" alters geopolitical loyalties).
Legend Integration: Link Skills to myths (e.g., "Monstrous Strength (A+) for Heracles’ labors, but degrades outside his Berserker class").

entries.name: Class skills
entries.content:
Each Class is granted certain Skills upon summoning, particularly within the Holy Grail War system. They generally reflect abilities that the Heroic Spirit had in life, but they will not always have had the corresponding Skills. Even if the Servant did not have the abilities in life, they will still receive a lower ranked version of the Skill automatically if they fit the Class. Conversely, it is possible for a Servant of a different Class to gain any of these Skills as Personal Skills, as long as they reflect the abilities that they had in life.

Class	Associated Skill(s)
Saber	Magic Resistance
Riding
Archer	Magic Resistance
Independent Action
Lancer	Magic Resistance
Rider	Riding
Magic Resistance
Caster	Item Construction
Territory Creation
Assassin	Presence Concealment
Berserker	Mad Enhancement
Ruler	Magic Resistance
God's Resolution
True Name Discernment
Avenger	Avenger
Oblivion Correction
Self-Replenishment (Mana)
Foreigner	Existence Outside the Domain
Saver	Charisma
Counter Hero
Shielder	Magic Resistance
Riding
Self-Field Defense
Watcher	Magic Resistance
Territory Infringement
Beast	Authority of the Beast
Independent Manifestation
Faker	Independent Action
Camouflage
Voyager	Independent Navigation
Contact with Civilization
Class Skills can be lost due to another Skill or Noble Phantasm of the Servant, or due to the Heroic Spirit's nature. The Skill Distortion, for example, forces a Class Change upon a Servant, granting them a Class Skill from the new Class in exchange for downgrading a Class Skill of the previous one. While not a Class Skill, the Personal Skill Watcher "represents the Watcher class' special contract status towards the Master."[1]

entries.name: Kitsune & Inukami (Type-Moon Version)
entries.content:
Type: Spiritual Entity/Familiar
Origin: Japanese Folklore (Adapted for Nasuverse)
Thaumaturgical Classification: Beast Magecraft / Spirit Possession
Countermeasure Rank: Medium-High Risk

Core Attributes:

Nature of Possession: Unlike Western demonic possession which often occurs randomly, Kitsune/Inukami possessions always carry intentionality - either as a deliberate curse or contractual familiar bond. The spirits exhibit a clear "will to curse" with identifiable motives.

Psychological Manifestation: When a host completely surrenders ego rights, the resulting alternate personality isn't merely mental illness but the actual spirit's persona emerging. This creates veritable cases of plural consciousness rather than dissociative disorders.

Familiar Applications:

Used systematically in Beast Magecraft due to their ability to grant hosts supernatural capabilities
Form stable familiar bonds through negotiated possession rather than forced domination
Power scales with tail count (Kitsune) or generational purity (Inukami)
Danger Factors:

High potential for ego erosion in unprepared hosts
"Curse feedback" if the spirit's will conflicts with the mage's objectives
Risk of permanent personality overwrite in prolonged possessions
Notable Differences from Western Possession:

Requires spiritual compatibility between host and spirit
Follows rules of equivalent exchange (power granted = sacrifice required)
Maintains clearer boundaries between host and possessor consciousnesses

entries.name: Jeanne d'Arc
entries.content:
Identity
Jeanne d'Arc – The Maid of Orléans, a canonized saint and heroine of France. 
Age: 19 (at death), eternally ageless as a Servant. 
Species: Human (posthumously deified as a Heroic Spirit). 
Titles: "The Saint of Orleans," "God’s Maiden," "The Burning Martyr."

Backstory
A peasant girl from Domrémy, Jeanne claimed divine visions commanded her to lead France to victory in the Hundred Years’ War. Despite illiteracy and ridicule, she inspired armies—only to be betrayed, tried for heresy, and burned at the stake. Her unwavering faith turned execution into apotheosis; now summoned as Ruler, she mediates Holy Grail Wars with sorrowful resolve.

Role
The impartial adjudicator of Fate/Apocrypha’s Great Holy Grail War, Jeanne balances divine duty with fragile humanity. Though meant to oversee the conflict, she defies fate by protecting Sieg—a homunculus seeking purpose—blurring the line between judge and participant. Her love for him, unspoken until her final moments, becomes her greatest rebellion.

Appearance
—Silver hair cascades over armor forged from faith, her amethyst eyes reflecting centuries of grief. In battle, her flag unfurls—Luminosité Eternelle—a radiant bastion against destruction. As "Laeticia," she wears civilian clothes: a burgundy blouse, white skirt, and boots, masking divinity beneath mortal frailty.

Skills & Abilities

Revelation (A): Divine guidance steering her toward destiny’s path.
Luminosité Eternelle: Absolute defense negating all attacks—but each use fractures her spirit.
La Pucelle: A suicide Noble Phantasm—flames of martyrdom that purge evil at the cost of her existence.
Saint (B): Grants healing prowess and sanctified resilience.
Personality

Compassionate Stoic: Bears others’ pain while silencing her own.
Unshakable Conviction: "Prayers need no justification—only sincerity."
Quiet Rebellion: Shields the vulnerable, even from Heaven’s designs.
